* Execute FastCast’s end-to-end digital media strategy across WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Reddit, and FastCast.com.
* Oversee the creation of engaging customer-focused content (independently or alongside agencies) to boost brand awareness and conversions.
* Act as the primary point of contact for the marketing tactics, offline and online, that include social media channels, performance marketing initiatives, influencer collaborations, print magazines, modern digital publications, public relations, targeted email campaigns, radio broadcasts, outdoor billboards, podcasts, and television. Review all deliverables for brand tone, cultural accuracy, and alignment with FastCast’s Indian identity.
* Build and nurture strong professional relationships with Indian casting directors, production houses, acting schools, talent agencies, and influencers to drive industry credibility and app adoption.
* Coordinate closely with our casting users to design and execute co-branded marketing campaigns, leveraging their reputation to establish FastCast's localised authority.
* Manage and update the FastCast.com website on WordPress, partnering with our global marketing team to apply best practices, optimize conversion, and keep design consistent across the Talent Systems portfolio.
* Execute targeted paid social media campaigns across Meta and Google platforms to drive user sign-ups across Indian cities.
* Monitor, analyse, and report on key marketing metrics, including follower growth, engagement rates, reach, and conversion to sign-ups, aligning all efforts with the company's subscriber milestones.
* Plan and execute photo and video shoots to capture imagery and content to use across FastCast's marketing channels
* Uphold brand guidelines, ensuring campaigns and services comply with company policies and local regulations.
* Partner with the cross-functional FastCast team to support and promote feature launches and events.

**Qualification & Attributes**

* Proven experience in digital marketing within the entertainment, media, or event industries.
* Previous experience working in a startup environment.
* Ability to take creative digital concepts from ideation through to launch.
* Experience managing social media agencies and/or external creative agencies.
* Ability to efficiently manage large-scale digital marketing channels and campaigns.
* Willingness and ability to work a full-time, 4-days-a-week schedule on-site at the Versova office.
* A commitment to providing exceptional service and a positive experience for all users and partners.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate challenges.
* Hands-on experience with photo shoots and event production is a plus.
* Tech-savviness with industry-standard content management systems and analytics tools.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

**What You Will Own**

**Growth and market strategy.**
Translate business ambition into a clear growth agenda across priority states, territories, crops, farmer segments, channels, and product lines. Own the marketing contribution to market expansion and revenue growth; this is a business-building role, not only a branding role.

**Farmer operating systems.**
Design scalable farmer programmes and operating models that connect the Doctor of Soil approach with farmer identification, agronomist-led advisory, product recommendations, field demonstrations, adoption tracking, and outcome measurement.

**Go-to-market and portfolio strategy.**
Develop product and segment strategies for RAKSHAK, POSHAK, and AMRITAM, including use-case prioritisation, value propositions, launch sequencing, market-entry plans, and differentiation grounded in product science and farmer needs.

**Market development and expansion.**
Partner with sales and agronomy teams to identify high-potential markets, understand crop and regional requirements, address adoption barriers, and build repeatable territory-level growth programmes.

**Demand generation and channel growth.**
Build integrated programmes across farmer engagement, dealer and distributor activation, institutional relationships, demonstrations, field days, trials, and relevant ATL, BTL, and digital channels to create demand and strengthen market pull.

**Market intelligence and farmer insight.**
Establish a continuous feedback loop using farmer conversations, field observations, channel inputs, trial results, and market data. Convert insights into product, messaging, pricing, and programme improvements.

**Commercial and cross-functional alignment.**
Work closely with business leadership, sales, agronomy, product/R&D, and operations to align marketing priorities with business targets, field capability, launch readiness, and product availability.

**Brand and science-led communication.**
Set clear positioning and communication standards for biological agricultural products. Ensure product benefits are explained simply and credibly, with claims and materials validated by relevant technical and regulatory stakeholders.

**Budget, measurement, and ROI.**
Own the marketing budget and performance dashboard. Define measures such as farmer reach, engagement, trials, conversion, repeat adoption, channel activation, territory growth, and programme return on investment.

**Marketing organisation and operating rhythm.**
Build the team, partner ecosystem, annual calendar, playbooks, review cadence, and execution standards required to scale marketing consistently across territories.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Strategic marketing and growth experience.**
Typically 10+ years of experience, including leadership of marketing, market development, or growth programmes in a business with strong field execution.

**Relevant industry exposure.**
Experience in agri-inputs, biologicals, agri-tech, seeds, crop nutrition/protection, biotechnology, or another science-led B2B/B2C business is strongly preferred.

**Farmer and channel understanding.**
Ability to understand farmer decision-making, on-ground adoption barriers, and the role of agronomists, dealers, distributors, and institutional partners.

**Programme design capability.**
Evidence of designing scalable operating programmes and go-to-market models, not just producing campaigns or brand collateral.

**Commercial and analytical mindset.**
Comfortable linking marketing plans to business outcomes, interpreting market data, setting KPIs, and reallocating resources based on results.
**Cross-functional leadership.**
Able to influence senior stakeholders and work effectively with sales, field teams, technical experts, and external partners.

**Communication and leadership.**
Can translate complex technical or biological product benefits into clear farmer- and channel-relevant messaging and lead teams through growth and change.

**Education.**
A degree in agriculture, life sciences, biotechnology, science, engineering, or business; an MBA or postgraduate qualification in marketing/agri-business is an advantage.

**Nice to Have**

Experience scaling a biological, microbial, or other agri-input product portfolio across multiple states.

Experience creating agronomist-led farmer engagement models, demonstration programmes, field trials, or data-backed adoption journeys.

Exposure to dealer/distributor networks, FPOs, institutional customers, or rural market development.

Experience building marketing systems and teams in a founder-led or growth-stage business.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. In the Indian pharmaceutical industry, majority of the top 30 organizations are revising their product portfolio to include complex generics, biologicals, biosimilars etc. They are also expanding into high-value therapy areas such as oncology, cardiology, immunology which contribute significantly in saving human lives. These customers are revisiting their go-to-market strategy to expand their presence in markets beyond US such as like Europe, LATAM, Japan and so on.

* Collaborate closely with all internal teams—Product, Services, Solution Consulting, Sales —both locally and globally, to evolve our offerings and maximize the value they deliver to customers.
* Identify opportunities for expansion and work with marketing and sales teams to define strategies to capture these customers.
* Own the growth plans and pricing strategies for our products in India.

**Requirements**

* Around 15 year’s experience working in India or global pharma industry either directly in or as a solution provider/consultant to the life sciences industry
* Understanding of Regulatory business processes and technology in the Life Sciences industry
* CEO mentality to drive outcomes internally and externally. Stays focused on results and drives execution among the team. Able to work with autonomy and adapt to change.
* Ability to critically think and develop a strategy and execution plan across all areas of business (Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Consulting, etc...)

* Has a purposeful vision about helping the pharma industry deploy innovative digital solutions to solve critical issues

* Worked with a software or systems integration company, either as an employee or part of a project

**Location**
: Lower Parel, Mumbai
  
  
**Experience**
: 6–8 years
  
  
**Education**
: MBA - Marketing

* Develop quarterly marketing plans and monthly promotional calendars in collaboration with the Hotels business team.

title: Sr Strategy & Execution Leader BioTech
description:
**About Paramverse Bio**

Paramverse Bio Pvt. Ltd. is building India’s next great bio company, with a focus on biological agriculture. Founded in 2024 and part of Paramverse Group, it develops and sells indigenous microbial formulations under the DHARITRI SUTRA™ brand. The portfolio spans 21 registered products across three lines: RAKSHAK (bio-protection), POSHAK (bio-nutrition), and AMRITAM (export-grade compliance).

Every product is delivered through the “Doctor of Soil” model: a certified agronomist, a personalised prescription, and data to show whether it worked. Paramverse Bio is live across nine Indian states in Phase 1 (FY27), with 48 territories, institutional-grade manufacturing, and field-to-export traceability.

**What You Will Own**

Platform Strategy & Cross-Industry Planning

* Drive end-to-end execution of key strategic programs across Paramverse Bio’s seven target industries — not just agriculture.
* Support the CEO’s Office in scoping new B2B verticals (pharma CDMO, food-grade enzymes, bio-surfactants, cosmetic actives) — market sizing, competitor mapping, PE-framework evaluation, and go/no-go recommendations.
* Build and maintain the cross-industry opportunity pipeline: track where capital is flowing, which sectors are maturing, and where Paramverse’s shared platform creates a structural cost or speed advantage.
* Coordinate the translation of platform-level capabilities (fermentation, AI, manufacturing) into industry-specific revenue plans across B2B2C (Agri), B2B (Pharma + Industrial), and B2C (Consumer Brands) channels.

Go-to-Market & Commercial Execution

* Partner with sales leadership, state heads, and commercial teams to track performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions across the agricultural biologicals business (Dharitri Sutra).
* Support market expansion and distribution growth across existing and new geographies — building structured GTM playbooks, retailer onboarding frameworks, and territory-level P&L dashboards.
* Coordinate with regulatory, agronomy, and external partners to support product registrations, compliance, field trials, and market-readiness activities across both agri and non-agri portfolios.
* Track competitive intelligence across all target sectors — funded startups, policy shifts, regulatory changes, and M&A activity that affects Paramverse’s positioning.

Manufacturing, Technology & Data

* Work with the manufacturing and R&D teams to track greenfield plant milestones, capacity utilisation, and the seasonal production-swing strategy (agri in Kharif, industrial in off-season).
* Support the AI and computational biology initiatives — tracking research partnerships, model development milestones, and the data flywheel that connects fermentation batches to field outcomes.
* Help build the business case for each manufacturing phase expansion — marginal capex analysis, capacity-revenue mapping, and utilisation economics.

Operations, Reporting & Governance

* Build structured project plans, milestones, dashboards, and review mechanisms to track progress and drive accountability across all active programs.
* Prepare CEO-facing reviews, MIS dashboards, investor updates, and board-level business recommendations.
* Manage cross-functional collaboration with Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and external advisors to ensure smooth operations.
* Analyse business and program performance data to generate insights and support decision-making — from per-acre unit economics in agri to EBITDA modelling for B2B pilot batches.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, solve ambiguous business problems, and implement scalable processes as the organisation grows from a single-market operation to a multi-industry platform.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Engineering degree with strong academic credentials; MBA from a leading business school preferred.
* 4–10 years of experience in Program Management, Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting, or General Management roles — ideally in environments that span multiple industries or business lines.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with a structured, first-principles approach to execution.
* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and driving outcomes without formal authority — across technical, commercial, and operational teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet.
* Ability to shift fluently between strategic thinking (market sizing, competitive positioning, capital planning) and hands-on execution (dashboards, vendor coordination, field visits).
* Strong written and verbal communication — you will prepare materials that go directly to the Founder, Governing Council, and investors.
* Intellectual curiosity about biology, fermentation, AI, and the broader bio-economy transition — you don’t need a science background, but you need to understand the platform at a technical level.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Biotechnology, AgriTech, Pharmaceuticals, CDMO, Specialty Chemicals, Food Ingredients, or FMCG — any sector where biology meets manufacturing at scale.
* Exposure sales operations, commercial excellence, GTM strategy, or multi-geography market expansion.
* Experience working directly with founders, C-suite leadership, or in a CEO’s Office / Founder’s Office capacity at a high-growth company.
* Familiarity with regulatory processes (CIB, FCO, FSSAI, CDSCO), product validation programs, or field trial management.
* Comfort with financial modelling — unit economics, capacity utilisation, PE-framework evaluation, and investor-grade business plans.
* Exposure AI/ML workflows, data platforms, or computational biology — even at a non-technical level.

Product Marketing

Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

The Role

You should understand that great social media isn’t always about big productions. Sometimes, a simple, minimal, well-designed post can make the biggest impact.

  Stay updated with trending reels, audio, formats, editing styles, and creative concepts that can help our brand stand out.

* Basic to intermediate graphic design skills using Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools.

Someone who enjoys creating content, notices the little details, understands what makes a social media page visually appealing, and wants to build a brand’s digital identity from the ground up.

What You’ll Get

* The opportunity to build and revamp the social media identity of an influencer marketing company.
* Exposure to brand campaigns, creators, influencers, and talent management.
* Creative freedom to experiment with ideas, formats, and visual styles.
* An opportunity to take ownership of our social media presence and grow with the company.

title: Head of E-Commerce & Quick Commerce
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-office)

**Function:**
E-Commerce & Quick Commerce

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. Marketplaces and quick commerce are two of our largest growth channels — this role owns both end to end: the revenue, the profitability, the operational health, and the team that runs them day to day.

**Role Overview**

This role owns Earthful's marketplace (Amazon, Flipkart, and similar) and quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and similar) channels end to end — revenue growth, channel profitability (CM2), and operational health metrics like fill rate and on-shelf availability. You'll build and lead a team of Key Account Managers, with all KAMs reporting into this role, and you'll be the one who decides where to invest, where to pull back, and how the team is structured to hit both channels' targets without sacrificing margin. You'll report directly to the founders on revenue, profitability, and ops performance.

**What You'll Own**

**Marketplace & Quick Commerce Revenue Growth**

• Own and grow marketplace & quick commerce revenue according to AOP across platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto)

• Set and track platform-wise revenue targets, adjusting strategy as performance data comes in

**Channel Profitability**

• Keep every channel CM2-positive, tracking contribution margin by platform on a monthly basis

• Own retail media and ad spend on marketplace and quick-commerce platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, Blinkit/Zepto sponsored placements), with ROAS targets that protect CM2 while hitting revenue goals

• Monitor competitive pricing and promotional activity on each platform, adjusting pricing and promotion strategy to protect margin and market share

**Operational Health Metrics**

• Track and sustain RIS%, PO fill rates, and on-shelf availability — with particular focus on quick commerce OSA given its real-time nature

• Coordinate with Supply Chain and Warehouse on demand forecasting and inventory allocation, so fill rate and OSA targets are actually achievable rather than just tracked after the fact

**Team Building & Leadership**

• Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of Key Account Managers (KAMs), with all KAMs reporting into this role

• Allocate platforms and accounts across the team, and set individual targets that ladder up to overall channel goals

• Build the team's capability so KAMs can independently manage platform relationships and day-to-day account operations

**Platform & Cross-Functional Relationship Management**

• Own strategic relationships with marketplace and quick-commerce platform category/account teams — unlocking better placements, programs, and support

• Coordinate new SKU listings and launches across all marketplace and quick-commerce platforms

• Coordinate with the Regulatory & Compliance team on marketplace listing compliance (claims, mandatory declarations) before SKUs go live

**Reporting**

• Report revenue, CM2, and operational metrics to leadership on a regular cadence, with a clear read on what's driving hits or misses

**What We're Looking For**

• 3+ years of experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or quick-commerce roles, including directly managing a team

• Proven experience owning contribution margin (CM1/CM2) or channel profitability for an e-commerce or marketplace channel, not just topline revenue

• Direct, hands-on experience managing retail media and ad spend on marketplace platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads) and/or quick-commerce sponsored placements

• A track record of scaling marketplace or quick-commerce revenue at a D2C or e-commerce brand

• Experience building or managing a team of Key Account Managers or similar account-owning roles

• Comfortable with operational metrics (fill rate, on-shelf availability, return rate) and coordinating with Supply Chain/Warehouse to hit them

• Strong analytical and Excel/dashboard skills

title: Head of Securities Services, India

Develop plans with multiple market access scenarios for generic entry and pricing impact. Develop second brand strategies when appropriate. title: Entrepreneur in Residence ( Fresher )
description:
About Clinderma

Clinderma is a tech-first teledermatology and prescription skincare company, incubated at IIT Madras. We've treated ~4,000 patients for acne and pigmentation — most of them came to us after nothing else worked.

We pair an AI skin system that learns each person's skin over time with real dermatologists and a human skin-coach layer. The goal: become the lifelong system of record for a person's skin, from acne to pigmentation to anti-aging.

Retention is strong — people stay once they're in. The problem we need solved is getting more of the right people in the door.

The role

You'll own Clinderma's growth engine end to end — acquisition, brand and content — and build it into a repeatable machine. This is a founder-level seat, not a marketing-manager role: you set strategy, run experiments yourself, and lead the content and marketing team.

Why EIR: we want someone who has built or wants to build a company, and who treats this as their own P&L. Strong performers can graduate into a leadership role or lead a new business line we incubate together.

What you'll own

**Acquisition (organic-first)**

* Build and scale organic channels — Instagram Reels (Hindi/Hinglish), YouTube, SEO, WhatsApp, community and referrals
* Grow and optimise the free AI skin test as our main lead magnet, and the funnel from test → consult → paid plan
* Run partnerships and offline channels: creators, clinics, colleges, corporate wellness
* Set up paid acquisition when budget opens up, with compliance for prescription-adjacent skincare (Meta policy, ASCI, NMC, CCPA)

**Brand and positioning**

* Sharpen how Clinderma stands - dermatologist-grade care, skin health beyond acne
* Own the brand voice through the shift to a warmer, more playful tone
* Build a face for the brand that isn't the founders: doctors within compliance, UGC creators, patient stories

**Content engine**

* Set the content strategy, pillars and calendar; lead the marketing manager and video editor
* Turn 4,000+ patient journeys into proof — before/afters, case stories, behind-the-scenes
* Ship hooks, scripts and formats fast; kill what doesn't work

**Growth systems**

* Own the funnel dashboard: CAC by channel, test-to-consult, consult-to-paid, payback
* Run a weekly experiment cadence and report learnings to founders
* Work with product on growth loops in the app and website

title: Vice President, Client Services
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

**About Mindshare : A Leading WPP Media Brand,**
Mindshare delivers Good Growth for its clients. As “Growth Architects," we drive growth that benefits all stakeholders — better for people, planet, and business — by using media with intention. This approach creates more meaningful connections with consumers, increases consumer trust in the brand, and delivers better outcomes for all stakeholders.
  
  
****Role Summary And Impact****
**Reporting of the Role**
This role reports to:
**Head — Strategy & Intelligence**
****3 Best Things About The Job****

* Category depth with business breadth - You own one category completely - its media landscape, its competitive dynamics, its consumer and cultural context. But you never lose sight of the business. Everything connects back to growth.
* Senior work from day one - This is a client-facing strategic leadership role. You will be in senior conversations, leading strategic recommendations and influencing how some of India's most iconic brands invest in media.
* A strategy practice - You will be joining a team that is reimagining what media strategy looks like - integrating AI, data intelligence and cultural thinking into a practice that goes well beyond traditional media planning.

**In This Role, Your Goals Will Be**
**In 3 months:**
Develop deep working knowledge of your assigned category - brands, competitive landscape, consumer context and media history. Build relationships with key internal and client stakeholders. Begin owning deliverables and contributing meaningfully to strategic discussions.
  
  
**In 6 months:**
Independently lead strategic presentations and recommendations for your category. Become the internal authority on category intelligence. Be proactively bringing insights and opportunities to client teams rather than only responding to briefs.
  
  
**In 12 months:**
Own the strategic agenda for your category. Lead major client reviews independently. Have measurably elevated the quality and ambition of strategic thinking for the portfolio. Be seen by clients as an indispensable strategic partner.
  
  
****Skills And Experience****
**Key Responsibilities**
**Category Strategy & Intelligence**
Lead the strategic intelligence agenda for your assigned category - synthesising competitive media activity, consumer behaviour, cultural trends and business dynamics into clear, actionable strategic narratives for client and internal teams.
  
  
**Client Partnership & Senior Stakeholder Engagement**
Build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across brand and media. Drive strategic discussions that connect media investment to brand equity and business outcomes - going beyond campaign execution to category growth thinking.
  
  
**Media Strategy Leadership**
Develop and own the media strategy for your category portfolio - grounded in planning rigour, informed by data and connected to the broader business agenda. Ensure strategy translates consistently from brief to plan to outcome.
  
  
**Competitive & Consumer Intelligence**
Maintain a current and nuanced understanding of the competitive media landscape, consumer media behaviour and emerging cultural trends. Translate these into timely, actionable recommendations that give the brand a strategic edge.
  
  
**Data & Insights**
Build bespoke strategic analyses, deep-dive studies and intelligence frameworks using media data, consumer research tools and secondary sources. Turn complex data into clear points of view.
  
  
**Thought Leadership & Collaboration**
Partner with Central planning, data and activation teams to ensure strategic intent is reflected at every stage of the media investment cycle. Contribute to agency thought leadership and category best practice.
  
  
****What Your Day Job Looks Like****

* Monitoring competitive activity, consumer signals and cultural trends to identify strategic opportunities and risks for your category brands.
* Building and presenting strategic analyses and recommendations for client brand and planning reviews - connecting media thinking to business outcomes.
* Working with planning and data teams to ensure category strategy is reflected accurately in media plans and measurement frameworks.
* Scanning secondary research, social listening tools and consumer survey platforms to build and update category intelligence.
* Adding strategic nuances to CCBT, MOC and AOP discussions - developing the category point of view that shapes investment decisions.
* Collaborating with Central strategy and intelligence teams to build category-specific frameworks, tools and best practices.

****What You Will Need****
**Must Have**

* 10–14 years of experience in media strategy, with a strong foundation of must-have 3–6 years in core media planning at a leading media agency. A solid grounding in planning mechanics - channel strategy, audience and reach thinking, platform dynamics, ROI frameworks - is essential for this role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver senior-level strategic recommendations - to category heads, marketing directors or equivalent - with confidence and clarity.
* Strong experience working on large FMCG or consumer brand accounts, with an understanding of how brand strategy, consumer insights and media investment connect to business outcomes.
* Excellent analytical capability - ability to work across multiple data sources (media, consumer, competitive, business) and synthesise a clear and actionable point of view.
* Outstanding communication skills - able to simplify complexity, build compelling narratives and present to senior internal and external audiences.
* A proactive, independent working style - someone who brings the agenda rather than waiting for the brief.

**Good to Have**

* Domain expertise in one of the following categories: Beauty & Wellbeing, Home Care, Personal Care or Foods & Nutrition.
* Experience on the brand or strategy side at an FMCG or digital media/tech company.
* Familiarity with AI-powered intelligence tools, social listening platforms and emerging media research methodologies.
* Experience contributing to brand planning, AOP or marketing strategy discussions beyond the media brief.
* Working knowledge of 1PD strategy, audience intelligence frameworks and data-driven planning approaches.

****Minimum Qualifications****

* Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience with a demonstrated foundation in media planning and a track record of strategic leadership.
* Experience managing senior client relationships independently.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Marketing Communications Manager
description:
Job Description – Marketing & Communications Manager - Standalone Airport Hotel

Role Purpose

The Marcom Manager owns the hotel's brand, voice and visibility. Without a chain's global marketing machine behind it, a standalone hotel depends on this role to build awareness, drive direct bookings and position the property against branded competitors.

The role leads all marketing, PR, digital, social media and content activity across rooms, F&B, weddings, MICE and spa, with clear accountability for brand reputation and revenue contribution.

Key Responsibilities

**Brand strategy and positioning**

The Marcom Manager develops and owns the hotel's annual marketing plan and budget, aligned with revenue and business goals. They define and protect the brand identity, tone of voice and visual standards across every touchpoint. Through regular competitor and market analysis, they position the hotel against branded and independent competitors, and manage memberships and affiliations such as Small Luxury Hotels, Preferred Hotels or Leading Hotels of the World, where applicable.

**Digital marketing and direct bookings**

The role drives direct-booking share through the hotel website, booking engine, SEO, SEM and metasearch platforms such as Google Hotel Ads and Tripadvisor. The Marcom Manager plans and runs paid campaigns on Google, Meta and other channels, tracking ROI and cost per acquisition. They manage website content, landing pages and conversion optimisation with the web agency, and run email marketing, CRM and guest-recognition communications. Working closely with Revenue Management, they shape promotions, packages and OTA content on MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Agoda and Expedia.

**Social media and content**

The Marcom Manager owns the social media strategy, content calendar and community management across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X. They commission and direct photo and video shoots and maintain an up-to-date asset library. They also manage influencer, creator and blogger partnerships with clear deliverables and measurable reach.

**Public relations and communications**

The role builds strong relationships with lifestyle, travel, food and business media to secure regular earned coverage. The Marcom Manager oversees the PR agency where retained, along with press releases, media familiarisation visits and interviews. Together with the General Manager, they lead crisis communication and keep the crisis communication plan current. They also handle internal communications, newsletters and employee engagement messaging in partnership with HR.

**Outlet, events and segment marketing**

The Marcom Manager creates and executes campaigns for F&B outlets, festivals, Sunday brunches, chef promotions and seasonal offers. They support the Sales team with collateral and campaigns for weddings, MICE, corporate and social events, and plan and deliver hotel launches, anniversaries and signature events.

**Online reputation management**

The role monitors and responds to reviews on Google, Tripadvisor, OTAs and social platforms within set timelines. The Marcom Manager analyses guest feedback trends, shares insights with operations leaders, and works to improve review scores and rankings on key platforms.

**Partnerships and collateral**

The Marcom Manager develops co-branded partnerships with luxury brands, banks, credit cards, airlines and lifestyle platforms, and manages barter, sponsorship and alliance agreements. They produce brochures, menus, signage, fact sheets, presentations and in-room collateral to brand standard.

**Budget, agencies and team**

The role manages the marketing budget, vendor contracts and the performance of creative, digital, PR and web agencies. The Marcom Manager leads, coaches and develops the marketing team, and reports monthly on marketing performance, spend and return to the General Manager and ownership.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured mainly on direct booking share and direct revenue against target, supported by website traffic, conversion rate and return on ad spend from paid campaigns. On social media, the focus is follower growth, engagement rate and reach, while PR success is judged by the number and value of earned media placements.

Reputation is tracked through Tripadvisor ranking, Google rating, OTA review scores and review response rate. The role is also measured on covers and revenue generated by promoted outlet and event campaigns, marketing spend held within the approved budget, and the engagement and retention of the marketing team.

Qualifications, Experience and Skills

**Education**

The candidate should hold a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism or Hotel Management. An MBA or PG Diploma in Marketing or Communications is preferred.

**Experience**

The role calls for 7–10 years in marketing and communications, including at least 3 years as a manager in a 5-star or luxury hotel. Experience in a standalone or independent luxury property is a strong advantage. The candidate should bring a proven record in digital marketing, direct-booking growth and media relations.

**Skills**

The ideal candidate has a strong command of digital channels, including SEO, SEM, Meta Ads, Google Hotel Ads and GA4 analytics. Excellent written and spoken English is essential, and a regional language is a plus. They should have a creative eye for photography, design and luxury aesthetics, along with working knowledge of Canva or Adobe Creative Suite, CMS platforms and CRM or email tools.

An established network with media, influencers and agencies is expected, together with sound budgeting, vendor management and reporting skills. The candidate must also show calm, sound judgment in crisis communication.

**Personal attributes**

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on professional who is comfortable building systems without chain support. The candidate should have a polished, confident presence with owners, guests and media, and be collaborative, detail-driven and able to manage multiple deadlines.

Working Relationships

Internally, the Marcom Manager works closely with the General Manager, Director of Sales, Revenue Manager, F&B team and Executive Chef, Rooms Division, Spa, HR, Finance and IT. Externally, the role engages with owners, PR, creative and digital agencies, media, influencers, OTAs, brand partners, affiliation bodies and vendors.

*This job description reflects the main duties of the role and is not exhaustive. The incumbent may be asked to take on other reasonable duties in line with business needs.*

Raise AI is a new business unit carved out to build AI-first products in financial services in India. fuzz (http://askfuzz.ai/) is our flagship product, along with a bunch of internal products used daily across the Raise group of companies.
  
  
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Associate, YouTube Marketing, to own and scale our YouTube and Instagram presence from the ground up. The role requires strong content instincts, SEO and analytics skills, and the ability to coordinate with editors and designers, so that every piece of content is high quality, discoverable and built to grow our audience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the YouTube and Instagram strategy, including positioning, content pillars, formats and a 3-6 month growth roadmap
* Build both channels from scratch and set up the content engine, publishing cadence and processes
* Plan and run long-form shows, Shorts and Reels, from guest and topic research to scripting and episode planning
* Lead editors, designers and videographers on edits, thumbnails, hooks and post-production quality
* Review cuts and share clear edit notes, and identify highlights and timestamps for clips
* Drive YouTube SEO and Instagram discovery through titles, thumbnails, keywords, captions, hashtags and retention
* Track performance weekly (CTR, watch time, retention, reach, saves, follower growth) and turn insights into experiments
* Create supporting carousels and social content, and repurpose across YouTube, Instagram.
* Source and coordinate guests, collaborators and creators
* Set and report on growth goals for subscribers, followers, views and engagement

**Skills**

* Proven experience building and scaling a YouTube channel and an Instagram page, ideally from scratch, with growth numbers you can share.
* Familiarity with AI video and content tools to speed up workflows and improve the quality of editing, scripting, thumbnails and repurposing.
* Deep understanding of YouTube SEO, the algorithm, thumbnails, retention and Instagram Reels and carousel mechanics
* Strong storytelling, scripting and editorial instincts, with a sharp eye for hooks and what makes content perform
* Hands-on experience managing editors, designers and freelancers
* Comfort with analytics tools such as YouTube Studio and Instagram Insights, and a data-driven approach to testing
* Strong communication and project management skills, and the ability to juggle multiple content pieces and deadlines
* Self-starter mindset with high ownership and minimal hand-holding

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!
  
  
**Our People & Culture**
People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.
  
  
We Are Looking For Team Members Just Like Us, In Simple Words - Good People To Work With And Demonstrate Following Personality Traits
  
  

* Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)
  
  

* We have a single opportunity to serve.

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,
  
  
uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)
  
  

* Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)
  
  

* Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)
  
  

* Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our
  
  
customers, not to prove a point.)
  
  

* Quality over quantity.

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)
  
  

* Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)
  
  

* Talent and Competency over Credentials.
* Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)
  
  

* Less words, more action.

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)
  
  

* Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)
  
  

* Passionate about the business you are a part of.

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)
  
  

* Raise is an equal opportunity employer.

(We celebrate diversity and inclusion.)
  
  
**Why Join Raise?**
We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion,
  
  
humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.
  
  
We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and
  
  
being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.
  
  
**About Raise Financial Services**
Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers.
  
  
Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform. Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Stratzy, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms. Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible
  
  
**Our Philosophy Is Simple**

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

**Location:**
Goregaon West, Mumbai
  
  
**Explore More**

* Connect with us: www.raiseholding.co
* Learn more about our Investing & Trading Platform – www.dhan.co
* Learn more about our AI Platform- https://askfuzz.ai/
* Follow our Instagram page LifeatRaise for a glimpse into our people and latest culture happenings.

**Apply For The Role**
If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech ecosystems, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
Send your resume to: careers@dhan.co
  
  
Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an
  
  
inclusive workplace.

title: Performance Marketing Manager – B2B & Growth
description:
**Job Description:**
**Performance Marketing Manager – B2B & Growth**

Job Description: Performance Marketing Manager – B2B & Growth

**Company:**
Expertrons

**Business:**
scale100x.ai

**Job Title:**
Performance Marketing Manager – B2B & Growth

**Location:**
Mumbai – Work from Office

**Experience:**
4–6 years

**Compensation:**
₹6–7.2 LPA

**ABOUT SCALE100X.AI**

**scale100x.ai**
, by Expertrons, is an AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer and emerging brands scale through franchise expansion, partner networks and strategic growth initiatives.

We work with high-potential brands across industries including
**EV, F&B, Beauty & Wellness, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more**
, helping them build scalable acquisition and expansion engines.

With
**300+ franchise and partner networks built**
, scale100x.ai combines performance marketing, sales, technology and AI to solve real growth problems for ambitious brands.

**ABOUT EXPERTRONS**

Expertrons is an AI-powered career experience platform trusted by experts from leading organisations including Microsoft, Amazon, Sequoia Capital and Harvard Business School.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**Performance Marketing Manager – B2B & Growth**
who can take ownership of our performance marketing function across multiple brands.

This is a
**player-coach role**
. You will lead and mentor the performance marketing team while remaining deeply hands-on with campaign strategy, execution, optimisation and scaling.

You will manage performance marketing across
**15+ brands**
, primarily focused on
**B2B lead generation, franchise acquisition, partner acquisition and high-ticket customer acquisition**
.

The ideal candidate understands that performance marketing is not just about generating leads. The objective is to generate
**qualified MQLs, sales opportunities and measurable business outcomes**
.

You will also be responsible for exploring
**ChatGPT, AI tools, automation and emerging acquisition channels**
to identify new and scalable ways to generate qualified demand.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Performance Marketing & Campaign Management

* Own the strategy, execution and optimisation of performance marketing campaigns across multiple brands.
* Plan, launch and manage
  **Meta Ads campaigns**
  for B2B lead generation and conversions.
* Develop campaign strategies based on business objectives, audience, geography, investment profile and business model.
* Manage budgets and scale successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency and lead quality.
* Continuously optimise audiences, creatives, messaging, offers, bidding strategies and campaign structures.
* Take end-to-end ownership of campaigns from
  **strategy → execution → optimisation → scaling**
  .

2. B2B, Franchise & High-Ticket Lead Generation

* Develop acquisition strategies targeting
  **founders, business owners, investors, franchise buyers, distributors, channel partners and decision-makers**
  .
* Build campaigns for high-ticket products, services and opportunities where potential transaction/investment values can range from
  **₹50 lakh to ₹1 crore+**
  .
* Understand the difference between lead volume and
  **qualified business acquisition**
  .
* Improve lead quality through audience segmentation, qualification, messaging, offers and funnel optimisation.
* Develop strategies to generate high-intent leads across multiple industries and business models.

3. Funnel & Conversion Optimisation

* Own the complete marketing-to-sales funnel:

**Lead → MQL → SQL → Opportunity → Conversion**

* Track and optimise
  **CPL, MQL rate, SQL rate, conversion rate, CAC and revenue contribution**
  .
* Work closely with Sales to identify lead-quality and conversion gaps.
* Use CRM and sales data to continuously improve campaign targeting and acquisition strategy.
* Develop retargeting and remarketing strategies for high-intent audiences.
* Identify drop-offs across the funnel and implement experiments to improve conversion.

4. Team Leadership & Management

* Lead, mentor and manage the performance marketing team.
* Set campaign priorities, performance targets and execution standards.
* Review campaign performance and ensure timely optimisation and corrective action.
* Train team members on Meta Ads, performance marketing, funnel optimisation, analytics and emerging acquisition strategies.
* Build a culture of experimentation, accountability and data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure the team consistently delivers against business and performance targets.
* Take ownership of the overall performance marketing function and team output.

5. AI, ChatGPT & Emerging Acquisition

* Explore
  **ChatGPT, AI platforms, AI tools, automation and emerging digital channels**
  to identify new acquisition opportunities.
* Experiment with new-age acquisition channels beyond traditional Meta and paid media.
* Identify opportunities to use
  **AI and automation**
  across lead generation, audience research, campaign optimisation, lead qualification and conversion.
* Test and validate new acquisition channels through structured experiments and measurable KPIs.
* Stay updated on emerging trends, platforms, tools and technologies in digital acquisition.
* Identify scalable opportunities that can improve lead quality, acquisition efficiency and overall growth.

6. Testing & Growth Experiments

* Design and execute A/B tests across:
* Audiences
* Creatives
* Ad copies
* Offers
* Landing pages
* Lead forms
* Campaign objectives
* Bidding strategies
* Funnel journeys
* Develop structured growth experiments to improve campaign performance.
* Analyse results, identify winning combinations and scale successful experiments.
* Continuously challenge existing strategies and look for new ways to improve acquisition.

7. Data & Performance Analytics

* Analyse campaign, CRM and sales data to identify performance trends, opportunities and bottlenecks.
* Build and maintain regular performance reports.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action quickly.
* Make decisions around budget allocation, audience strategy and campaign scaling based on data.
* Connect marketing metrics with actual sales and business outcomes rather than focusing only on CPL.

8. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with
  **Sales, Creative, Marketing, Technology, Product and Leadership teams**
  .
* Collaborate with Creative teams to develop performance-driven creatives and messaging.
* Work with Sales to understand lead quality, objections, conversion challenges and customer feedback.
* Translate business goals into measurable performance marketing strategies.
* Present performance insights, experiments and recommendations to leadership.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–6 years of experience**
  in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing or Digital Acquisition.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Meta Ads Manager**
  .
* Proven experience in
  **B2B lead generation and acquisition campaigns**
  .
* Experience with
  **franchise, high-ticket products/services, SaaS, education, real estate, financial services or similar high-value businesses**
  is preferred.
* Strong understanding of
  **MQL, SQL, funnel metrics, lead qualification and conversion optimisation**
  .
* Experience managing multiple campaigns, brands or accounts simultaneously.
* Prior experience
  **leading, mentoring or managing a performance marketing team**
  .
* Strong understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, campaign scaling and budget optimisation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with CRM and marketing analytics data.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between marketing performance and sales outcomes.
* **Curiosity and hands-on interest in ChatGPT, AI tools, automation and emerging acquisition channels.**
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong ownership and execution mindset.

**YOU WILL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU**

* Think beyond
  **lead volume and CPL**
  and focus on
  **MQLs, SQLs, opportunities and revenue**
  .
* Can balance
  **team leadership with hands-on campaign execution**
  .
* Understand how to reach and convert
  **founders, business owners, investors and high-intent B2B audiences**
  .
* Can independently take campaigns from
  **strategy → launch → optimisation → scaling**
  .
* Enjoy experimenting with audiences, creatives, funnels, AI tools and new acquisition channels.
* Are comfortable managing multiple brands across different industries and target audiences.
* Use data to make decisions rather than assumptions.
* Are curious about how
  **AI and emerging technologies can transform customer acquisition**
  .
* Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where ownership, speed and measurable outcomes matter.

**WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT**

This is
**not a traditional Meta Ads execution role**
.

You will have the opportunity to:

* **Lead and mentor the performance marketing team.**
* Personally manage high-impact campaigns across
  **15+ brands**
  .
* Work on
  **B2B, franchise, partner and high-ticket acquisition**
  .
* Build complete marketing-to-sales funnels.
* Explore
  **ChatGPT, AI, automation and emerging acquisition channels**
  .
* Experiment with new growth strategies and technologies.
* Work directly with founders, leadership and business teams.
* Influence
  **MQLs, sales opportunities, CAC and revenue**
  .
* Build scalable acquisition systems that can be replicated across multiple businesses.

**WHY SCALE100X.AI?**

If you want to simply manage ad campaigns, this may not be the right role.

If you want to
**lead a performance marketing team, build B2B acquisition engines, work across multiple brands, experiment with AI and emerging channels, solve real growth problems and directly influence business outcomes**
, we'd love to hear from you.

**Join scale100x.ai and help build the next generation of scalable B2B growth engines.**

title: Digital Account Manager (Social + Media)
description:

**Position:**

**Digital Account Manager (Social + Media)**

**Must Have :**
Minimum of 5 years of working experience at an advertising agency or a design agency or a digital marketing agency.

**Location: Mumbai, India**

**About Brandmovers:**

Brandmovers is a global creative technology agency network, headquartered in Atlanta with other offices in New York, London and Mumbai.

Brandmovers India, born and bred in Mumbai since 2011, is one of the older creative digital agencies who have stood the test of time in India’s digital revolution.

Our motto of “less ordinary and more powerful” comes alive in our partnerships with some of the world’s fastest growing companies and most admired brands including including Manchester United, Universal Studios, Pepsi, KFC, Doritos, Loreal, Hilton, Titan, Fastrack, Westside, United Colors of Benetton, The Bodyshop, Luxottica (Vogue Eyewear & Oakley), Unilever (Lakme Salon & Elle18), Aditya Birla Group, Jack Daniel's, Moët Hennessy (LVMH), Reebok Classics, Biba, ORRA, Myntra, Swiggy and many others.

https://www.instagram.com/brandmoversindia/

careers@brandmovers.in

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Suspire Marketing Manager - Brand, Growth & Product Marketing**

**Location:**
 Vile Parle (West), Mumbai | 
**Type:**
 Full-time, On-site | 
**Joining:**
 Immediate

**Experience:**
 2-3 years | 
**Reports to**
: Founder and the CMO

**About Suspire**

Suspire makes better living easier, through wellness-first, thoughtfully curated choices you can

trust. We are a 4-year-old startup building an ecosystem of 400+ sustainable brands, 500,000+

conscious community members, and 100,000+ delivered eco-friendly gifts. Our mission: help

people live healthier, stronger and calmer lives by building a high-trust wellness ecosystem.

We are a tight, high-ownership team at a critical growth stage. Every hire shapes our future.

**The Team You'll Lead: Marketing**

Suspire's full-stack marketing team isn't just about promotions; it owns our end-to-end digital

presence, brand voice, customer journeys, content, data analysis and revenue-generating

initiatives. We also build products and in-house technology. Suspire sits at an exciting

intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, so marketing here touches almost every part

of the business. You'll lead a dynamic department that drives real business and proactively

accelerates Suspire’s growth journey.

**The Role**

Own marketing at Suspire as our Marketing Manager at a pivotal moment. The role sits between

a brand manager and a growth marketer, with a product mindset: you will set how the brand

shows up, own growth and the best use of budgets, and help shape the features and products

that serve our customers, our partner brands and our B2B clients.You will be a driving force behind our new branding and repositioning, and behind taking Suspire to its next level. This is not a one-dimensional role: the right person sees how every decision lands on sales, customers, finances and brand reputation, and decides accordingly.

**Your core responsibilities:**

●
**Strategy and brand:**
 Build and own the marketing strategy and plan, and own Suspire's

positioning, brand voice and consistency across channels as the new brand rolls out.

●
**Growth and budgets:**
 Own the marketing budget. Plan, allocate and optimize it across

paid, organic and retention, track returns, costs and contribution, and make fast

scale-or-stop calls.

●
**Channels and campaigns:**
 Direct end-to-end digital marketing funnels and customer

lifecycle management across Meta, Google, Instagram and social, website, SEO, PR,

email and WhatsApp, with content that can double as performance creative.

●
**Product thinking**
: Partner with tech and product teams to shape customer experience

and features, and to package offerings that can be sold to our partner brands and B2B

clients.

●
**Launches:**
 Plan and run launches from narrative and assets through rollout sequencing

based on audience and objective, followed by post-launch review.

●
**Agencies and cross-functional work:**
 Brief, manage and review external agencies,

and coordinate across ops, sales, design and tech so teams move in the same direction.

●
**Reporting and leadership communication:**
 Track and analyse performance, and

translate it into clear updates, trade-offs and recommendations for the founder and the

CMO.

●
**AI-led ways of working:**
 Use AI to sharpen strategy, speed up execution, stress-test

ideas and improve creative work, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

●
**People and systems:**
 Lead, coach and set priorities for the in-house team, raise the

quality bar, and build simple systems and SOPs so the team runs well without you in

every decision.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't just hand work to agencies, and you won't just

execute tasks yourself. You set the direction, hold the quality bar, make the call and keep things

moving.

**Primary KPIs**

Marketing-driven Revenue and Contribution | Channel-wise Performance | Budget Efficiency |

End-to-End Customer Experience | Average Order Value | Lifecycle & Retention Metrics |

Organic Growth | Experiment Velocity (test, learn, scale or kill) | Products Build & Launch

delivery | Team and agency output quality | Effort-Result Ratio

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves:**

● 2-3 years of marketing experience with a strong grasp of marketing, brand and customer

behaviour fundamentals.

● Ownership at manager level: you take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions even

with incomplete information, and own the results.

● Big-picture judgement: you can see the impact of decisions on sales, customers,

finances and brand reputation, and balance them.

● Taste and judgement: you can review creative, content and campaigns, give sharp,

constructive feedback and decide what ships.

●nSpeed: you enjoy building, measuring and fixing quickly, you keep what works, and you

kill ideas fast when they don't.

● A real pulse on teams: you understand what ops, sales, design and tech need and plan

your work so it lands well across functions and with leadership.

● Team leadership: you have led, mentored or coordinated people, interns or agencies,

and you enable others instead of doing everything yourself.

● Working familiarity with Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM

platforms and Excel or Sheets. You don't need to be a hands-on technical expert, but

you should know enough to brief, audit and challenge.

● Fluent English and Hindi (spoken) with strong written English.

**AI is part of how we work:**

● You use AI regularly (ChatGPT, Claude, Lovable, etc.) for strategy, execution,

stress-testing ideas and creative work, and you know how to prompt clearly and iterate.

● You have the taste to judge AI-generated output and decide what is good enough to

ship.

● You are curious about building agentic and AI-assisted workflows that cut manual effort.

**Good-to-haves:**

● Experience in e-commerce or D2C brands (a big plus), including familiarity with Shopify.

● Exposure to a range of digital marketing formats, from paid and social to SEO, email,

WhatsApp and content.

● Digital marketing certifications, for example in Google Ads, Google Analytics or Meta

**Education:**
 A Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business or a related field is strongly

preferred.

**Why Join Suspire**

● Join at a pivotal moment: a new brand and positioning, with you helping to shape it.

● Report directly to the founder and the CMO, and work closely with leadership on most

decisions.

● Work at the intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, and see how marketing

connects to product and revenue.

● Take real ownership of strategy, budgets, experiments and a team, and see the impact of

your work quickly.

Suspire appreciates energetic ideas, coupled with even better execution. We welcome trial and

error and give you complete room to grow, explore and build, just like Suspire itself does.

**How to Apply**

Share your 
**CV + a short note**
 at 
swayam.doshi@suspire.in
 on the following:

● Why you'd like to work with Suspire.

● One marketing decision you made, such as scaling or killing a campaign or idea quickly,

and what made you decide.

Feel free to reach out to us on Instagram (@suspire.in) / LinkedIn if you'd like to chat, ask

questions or simply get a feel of the brand. Meanwhile, explore our website and socials to

understand our community, brands and philosophy.

**Thank you for your interest in being part of Suspire's journey. We would be happy to**

**connect and explore whether this role and our team are the right fit for you.**

title: Assistant Manager - Influencer Marketing Operations
description:
Next Step HR is hiring for a marketing firm working across
**influencer marketing, website marketing, and performance marketing**
. The organisation brings together creator partnerships and digital growth initiatives to help brands strengthen their online presence, engage audiences, and achieve measurable marketing outcomes.

**Location - Lower Parel, Mumbai**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The organisation is looking for an organised, proactive, and detail-oriented
**Assistant Manager – Influencer Marketing Operations**
to work closely in the
**Founder’s Team**
.

The role will be responsible for overseeing the operational execution of influencer campaigns, coordinating with creators and stakeholders, and ensuring campaign workflows, timelines, and deliverables stay on track from planning through closure.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Influencer Campaign Execution:**
  Coordinate campaigns end-to-end, from briefing and creator selection to content approvals, publishing, deliverable tracking, and closure.
* **Creator & Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Liaise with influencers, talent managers, agencies, clients, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and timely execution.
* **Campaign Operations:**

* **Client Servicing:**
  Share campaign updates, clarify requirements, and facilitate smooth coordination between brands and execution teams.
* **Reporting & Performance Tracking:**
  Track deliverables, reach, engagement, impressions, and other relevant campaign metrics. Prepare campaign status updates and post-campaign reports.
* **Budget & Documentation:**
  Maintain records of creator commercials, campaign expenses, approvals, and completed deliverables.
* **Founder’s Team:**
  Take ownership of assigned priorities, support operational planning, and identify opportunities to improve campaign processes and execution.

**KEY REQUIREMENTS**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in
  **influencer marketing, influencer campaign management, digital marketing operations**

title: Social Media Executive
description:
**Title:**
**Social Media Executive**

Job Location: Worli (Mumbai)

Reports to: Head of Sales

Salary: ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 a month in hand, plus benefits

Work mode: Hybrid, Mumbai (office and home)

**ABOUT BAROMETER**

Barometer Technologies is a Mumbai company that helps food and beverage businesses control their inventory and costs. We are a software company that goes beyond software: every client gets our products and a dedicated operations expert.

Our two products are MATS, for kitchen, store and outlet inventory, and Bar, for bar, pub and club inventory. They cover purchase, recipe costing, stock counts, wastage, pour cost and reports. They connect with tools that our clients already use, for example Petpooja, UrbanPiper, Tally and Zoho Books.

Our team also does the hands-on work: data audits, onboarding, monthly expert reviews, SOPs and custom reports. More than 300 outlets use Barometer. They include restaurants, bars, cafés, bakeries, QSRs, cloud kitchens and fine-dine groups such as The Bombay Canteen and Khar Gymkhana.

Our buyers are restaurant owners, chefs and bar managers. So our content is about food, drink, and the money behind both.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

You own Barometer's social media, from the strategy to the last post. You decide what we post, where, and why. Then you make it happen: you plan the calendar, make the creatives, post on time, and measure the results.

You work closely with the sales team, so our content brings in real enquiries from restaurant owners. The strategy, the execution and the results are all yours.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Own the strategy

• Set the social media strategy for Barometer: the goals, the platforms, the content themes, the formats and how often we post.

• Agree targets for reach, engagement, follower growth and leads with the Head of Sales.

• Turn the strategy into a monthly content plan, and present it before the month starts.

• Track what competitors and F&B brands post. Bring new ideas to the team.

• Review the results every month. Keep what works, drop what does not, and change the plan.

2. Run the accounts

• Own the content calendar for Instagram, LinkedIn and the other platforms where we are active. Plan one week ahead and keep it full.

• Schedule and publish posts, reels, stories and carousels.

• If a post waits for an approval, chase that approval. Do not let the slot pass.

• Reply to comments and DMs. Send every real sales enquiry to the sales team on the same day.

• Keep a simple sheet of what went out, when, and how it did. Keep it current.

3. Make the creatives

• Build static posts, carousels and light reels in Canva, or in a tool that you are fast in. Use our templates and brand guidelines.

• Write captions and hooks in plain English. Our readers are restaurant owners and F&B managers, not marketers.

• Reuse what we already have. Case studies, product screenshots, blog posts and webinar clips can all become social content.

• Edit short videos for reels and shorts. CapCut or Premiere Rush is fine.

4. Report results

• Prepare a short monthly report against the targets: reach, engagement, follower growth, profile clicks and leads.

• Tell us plainly what works and what does not. If a format fails three times, tell us then. Do not let us find out two months later.

5. Support sales and campaigns

• Make creatives for email and WhatsApp campaigns.

• Make collateral for events and trade shows.

• Do small content updates on our website.

• Talk to the sales team often, so that our posts match the questions that clients actually ask.

REQUIREMENTS

Must have

• You can plan a social media strategy and explain the reasons behind it. You know which formats work, on which platform, and how often to post.

• You post on Instagram and LinkedIn yourself. You do not only scroll.

• Real Canva skill. Send us your work, not certificates.

• Clear written English. Our clients read your captions.

• Dependability. In this job, posts that go out on time and work that you finish count for more than raw talent.

• You accept feedback. You can redo a creative two or three times without a problem.

• A degree in any stream. Marketing or mass communication helps, but it is not compulsory. Freshers with strong work samples can apply.

Good to have

• Short video edits for reels.

• Time spent in restaurants, bars or hotels. A part-time job at a café also counts.

• Some use of Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn page analytics, or a scheduling tool.

• Good phone photography.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Salary: ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 a month in hand.

• Internet allowance: ₹500 a month.

• Time off: paid leave, and all national holidays off.

• Hybrid work: part of the week in our Mumbai office, part from home.

• A seat next to sales: you report to the Head of Sales, so you hear how restaurants are actually sold to. Most marketing jobs never get near those conversations.

• Live accounts: you run our real accounts. Your work goes out under the Barometer name from week one.

• Real F&B knowledge: you learn how food businesses run: food cost, inventory and margins. This knowledge is useful in hospitality and in SaaS marketing.

• Room to grow: as we grow, the role grows with you. Good results lead to more responsibility in our marketing.

**HOW TO APPLY**

• Apply through this job post.

• Add a link to 3 to 5 samples of your work: Canva posts, carousels, reels, or a page that you run.

• Add a short note, maximum 150 words: how will you grow Barometer on Instagram or LinkedIn in your first three months?

• Tell us your earliest start date.

We shortlist only applications that include work samples.

title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
