title: Growth Manager
description:
**Position:  Growth Manager** 




**Function: Growth / D2C / Marketing (Retention\+ CRM\+ P\&L)** 




**Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Nutrition, Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Lifestyle** 




**Location: Mumbai** 




**Experience: 7–10 years** 




**Reporting To: Director** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven Growth \& Retention leader who can own the complete D2C growth charter with a strong focus on revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, retention, repeat purchases and P\&L management.
 



 The role will be responsible for building and scaling the D2C business by combining performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, loyalty, CRO, analytics and commercial decision\-making.
 



 The ideal candidate should have experience working with a consumer\-facing brand, preferably within D2C, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty, personal care or lifestyle, and should be comfortable operating at the intersection of growth, marketing, technology, analytics and business P\&L.
 



  





**1\. D2C Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 




 ·       Own the overall D2C revenue and P\&L, including revenue growth, gross margins, contribution margins, CAC, LTV and profitability.
 



 ·       Develop and execute annual and quarterly D2C growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
 



 ·       Identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer value and channel efficiency.
 



 ·       Own monthly growth targets and develop actionable plans to achieve them.
 



 ·       Monitor Revenue, AOV, CAC, LTV, ROAS, repeat rate, retention and contribution margin.
 



 ·       Drive data\-led decisions on marketing investments, product mix, promotions and customer segments.
 



  





**2\. Customer Acquisition \& Performance Marketing** 




 ·       Lead performance marketing across Meta, Google and other relevant acquisition channels.
 



 ·       Scale acquisition while maintaining a healthy CAC\-to\-LTV ratio.
 



 ·       Work with performance marketing teams/agencies to optimise campaign performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies for customer acquisition and efficient media spends.
 



 ·       Diversify acquisition through organic, partnerships, SEO/AEO/GEO, referral and other growth channels.
 



 ·       Establish clear attribution and measurement frameworks.
 



  





**3\. Retention \& CRM** 




 ·       Own the complete customer retention and lifecycle marketing charter.
 



 ·       Increase repeat purchases, customer frequency, retention and LTV.
 



 ·       Develop lifecycle journeys for new, repeat, dormant, high\-value and churn\-risk customers.
 



 ·       Drive CRM through Email, WhatsApp, SMS, push and other relevant channels.
 



 ·       Build journeys covering onboarding, first\-to\-second purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell/upsell, win\-back, loyalty and VIP customers.
 



 ·       Use RFM, cohort and behavioural segmentation to personalise communication.
 



 ·       Track cohort\-level retention and identify opportunities to improve LTV.
 



  





**4\. Loyalty \& Monetisation** 




 ·       Build and scale loyalty, rewards, referral and membership programs.
 



 ·       Increase customer frequency and basket size.
 



 ·       Develop monetisation strategies that improve customer value without negatively impacting contribution margins.
 



 ·       Analyse loyalty adoption, repeat behaviour and profitability.
 



  





**5\. Growth Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 ·       Establish a growth dashboard covering the customer funnel.
 



 ·       Analyse cohorts, acquisition sources, retention curves and LTV.
 



 ·       Conduct A/B testing and CRO across website, landing pages, product pages, checkout and customer journeys.
 



 ·       Identify funnel drop\-offs and work with Product/Tech to improve conversion.
 



 ·       Build forecasting models for revenue, acquisition, retention and marketing spends.
 



 ·       Translate data into business recommendations for leadership.
 



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 ·       Work closely with Brand, Product, Creative, Technology, Analytics, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations.
 



 ·       Align growth initiatives with inventory, launches, pricing and promotional calendars.
 



 ·       Partner with Finance to track P\&L, contribution margins and marketing ROI.
 



 ·       Work with Product and Tech to improve D2C customer experience and conversion.
 



 ·       Lead internal teams and external agencies/vendors across growth, CRM, performance and partnerships.
 



  





**7\. Organic \& Emerging Growth Channels** 




 ·       Explore emerging acquisition channels beyond traditional paid media.
 



 ·       Develop SEO, AEO and GEO strategies to increase organic discovery and reduce dependence on paid acquisition.
 



 ·       Track traffic, conversion and revenue from organic and emerging search surfaces.
 



 ·       Identify new digital platforms, partnerships and consumer touchpoints contributing to D2C growth.
 



  





**Key KPIs** 




 ·       D2C Revenue Growth
 



 ·       P\&L / Contribution Margin
 



 ·       Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 



 ·       Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
 



 ·       LTV:CAC
 



 ·       Repeat Purchase Rate
 



 ·       Customer Retention
 



 ·       Revenue from Existing Customers
 



 ·       New Customer Acquisition
 



 ·       AOV
 



 ·       Purchase Frequency
 



 ·       ROAS / Marketing Efficiency
 



 ·       CRM Revenue Contribution
 



 ·       Conversion Rate
 



 ·       Cohort Retention
 



 ·       Loyalty Program Adoption \& Revenue
 



 ·       Organic Revenue Contribution
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 ·       7–10 years of experience in Growth, D2C, CRM, Retention, Performance Marketing or related consumer businesses.
 



 ·       Owned or significantly contributed to a D2C P\&L.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience in customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
 



 ·       Experience managing performance marketing budgets and understanding CAC and ROAS optimisation.
 



 ·       Strong understanding of LTV, cohorts, RFM, retention and customer segmentation.
 



 ·       Experience building CRM automation and lifecycle journeys.
 



 ·       Strong commercial mindset and understanding of growth, revenue and profitability.
 



 ·       Comfortable working with data and making decisions based on analytics.
 



 ·       Experience managing cross\-functional teams and external agencies.
 



 ·       Able to operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high ownership.
 



  





**Preferred Industry Background** 




 D2C \| FMCG \| Nutrition \| Health \& Wellness \| Beauty \| Personal Care \| Food \& Beverage \| Lifestyle \| Consumer Internet \| E\-commerce
 



 Experience with a high\-frequency or repeat\-purchase consumer category would be an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Tools / Platforms** 




 Shopify \| CleverTap \| MoEngage \| WhatsApp Business API \| Meta Ads \| Google Ads \| GA4 \| Unicommerce \| Marketing Automation \& CRM Platforms
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person in this role will be expected to build a profitable and scalable D2C growth engine, where acquisition and retention work together—driving new customer growth while continuously increasing repeat revenue, LTV and contribution margins.
 



 This role is not a pure Performance Marketing or CRM role; it requires someone who can connect Growth \+ Retention \+ Analytics \+ Commercial/P\&L ownership into one business charter.
 



  





 Interested candidate can share their CV at
 **hr@aceblend.com**

 As the National Head – Activations \& BTL Marketing, the incumbent will be responsible for bringing Kotak's brands, propositions and customer experiences alive across markets through branch\-led marketing, customer engagement platforms, experiential activations, events, community outreach and hyperlocal marketing initiatives.
 



 The role sits at the intersection of marketing and business growth, transforming national strategy into market\-level impact. It will lead activation programmes that drive customer acquisition, deepen engagement, strengthen brand affinity and create sustained visibility across Consumer and Commercial Banking.
 



 Beyond programme delivery, the mandate is to build a scalable activation engine that empowers business teams and branches across the country to win in their local markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Build Kotak's National Activation Ecosystem
 


* Define the long\-term vision and strategy for BTL marketing, customer engagement and on\-ground activations across Consumer and Commercial Banking.
* Create scalable activation frameworks that can be deployed nationally while remaining relevant to local market opportunities.
* Establish activation marketing as a key driver of business growth, customer acquisition and proposition adoption.
* Build a differentiated market presence for Kotak through innovative customer engagement platforms and experiences.



 Lead Branch \& Regional Marketing Excellence
 


* Develop and institutionalise a national branch marketing framework across Kotak's network.
* Enable branch and regional business teams with scalable programmes that generate awareness, engagement and qualified leads within local markets.
* Drive hyperlocal marketing interventions tailored to regional opportunities, customer segments and business priorities.
* Partner with business and sales leaders to convert market opportunities into impactful activation plans.



 Drive Customer Acquisition \& Demand Generation
 


* Create activation programmes that support acquisition goals across Retail, Affluent, NRI, SME and Commercial Banking segments.
* Build market\-facing engagement programmes that generate qualified leads and improve conversion outcomes.
* Develop segment\-specific activation strategies to support key propositions and business priorities.
* Create clear and measurable linkages between marketing investment and business outcomes.



 Build Signature Customer Engagement Platforms
 


* Conceptualise and lead Kotak's portfolio of customer events, business forums, thought\-leadership platforms, community initiatives and experiential programmes.
* Develop proprietary properties and engagement platforms that strengthen customer relationships and improve brand salience.
* Create memorable experiences that reinforce Kotak's positioning and customer\-centric philosophy.
* Drive innovation across physical, digital and phygital engagement formats.



 Lead Execution at National Scale
 


* Oversee end\-to\-end implementation of activation programmes across multiple geographies and business segments.
* Build best\-in\-class execution capabilities through agencies, vendors and regional partners.
* Establish governance, operating rhythms and performance standards that ensure consistent delivery across markets.
* Drive operational excellence, process compliance, budget discipline and brand consistency.



 Measure Impact \& Build Capability
 


* Establish robust measurement frameworks to track activation effectiveness, lead quality and return on investment.
* Build a data\-led activation culture focused on learning, optimisation and continuous improvement.
* Identify emerging trends in experiential marketing, customer engagement and local market activation.
* Develop internal capabilities, playbooks and best practices that strengthen Kotak's activation ecosystem.



  





**Role Boundaries \& Collaboration** 




 This role owns the strategy and delivery of BTL marketing, experiential engagement, branch\-led marketing and national activation programmes. It will collaborate with the Alliances function where an existing alliance or partner requires activation support, while ownership of alliance strategy, partner identification, commercial negotiation and relationship management remains outside this role's mandate.
 



  





**Key Leadership Competencies** 




 Strategic Growth Orientation
 



 Translates business priorities into scalable market\-facing programmes that drive acquisition, engagement and revenue growth. Focuses on outcomes rather than activity volumes.
 



 Customer \& Market Centricity
 



 Brings a deep understanding of customer behaviour, market dynamics and regional nuances to create relevant and differentiated experiences.
 



 Enterprise Leadership \& Influence
 



 Builds alignment across business heads, regional leadership, sales, distribution, marketing and support functions. Influences successfully without direct authority.
 



 Commercial Acumen
 



 Understands business economics, channel dynamics and growth drivers. Makes investment choices with a clear view of customer value, ROI and commercial impact.
 



 Execution Excellence at Scale
 



 Leads complex, nationally distributed programmes while balancing speed, quality, consistency and governance.
 



 Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
 



 Challenges conventional approaches and creates new ways to engage customers, improve effectiveness and build competitive advantage.
 



 Data\-Led Decision Making
 



 Uses insights, analytics and performance measures to optimise programmes, allocate investment and improve outcomes.
 



 Building High\-Performance Teams
 



 Creates accountability, ownership and continuous learning. Develops talent and builds strong internal, agency and vendor partnerships.
 



 Stakeholder Management \& Executive Presence
 



 Communicates with clarity and confidence, engages senior leadership effectively and represents marketing priorities in strategic business discussions.
 



 Entrepreneurial Mindset
 



 Acts with ownership and agility, identifies opportunities and proactively builds new capabilities to support growth ambitions.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years of experience in BTL marketing, experiential marketing, trade marketing, branch marketing, customer engagement or demand generation.
* Proven experience leading nationally distributed activation programmes across multiple regions and customer segments.
* Strong experience partnering with large sales, branch and distribution organisations.
* Experience in banking, financial services, telecom, consumer goods, retail, hospitality or other large\-scale services organisations preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of driving customer acquisition, market development and measurable business impact through on\-ground marketing.
* Experience managing significant budgets, agencies, vendors and complex cross\-functional stakeholder networks.
* Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business Management or a related discipline preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* A nationally scaled activation engine that strengthens Kotak's presence and local relevance across priority markets.
* Best\-in\-class branch and regional marketing capabilities across the network.
* Meaningful contribution to customer acquisition, lead generation and proposition adoption.
* Signature customer engagement platforms that differentiate Kotak in priority segments.
* Consistent, measurable return on activation investments.
* A culture in which activation marketing is recognised as a strategic growth partner to the business.



  





**The Leadership Profile We Are Looking For** 



* A growth\-oriented marketing leader, not simply a campaign or events manager.
* Equally comfortable discussing business strategy, customer acquisition and market development, and reviewing market\-level execution.
* Passionate about building Kotak's presence in local markets and creating customer experiences that drive measurable impact.
* Skilled at operating in a matrixed environment and mobilising large stakeholder groups towards a shared objective.
* Capable of building a nationally scaled activation engine that becomes a competitive advantage for the bank.



  





 BUILD THE ENGINE THAT TURNS KOTAK'S STRATEGY INTO MARKET IMPACT.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
***ABOUT THE COMPANY***




  





 Messe Berlin India is a subsidiary of Messe Berlin GmbH, one of the world’s leading trade fair and conference organisers. As part of Messe Berlin’s international network, Messe Berlin India is focused on developing and expanding the company’s presence in the Indian market through a growing portfolio of B2B exhibitions and conferences across key industry sectors.
 



  





***RESPONSIBILITIES***




  





 We are looking for a creative, organised, and detail\-oriented Marketing Manager to join our team in India. The role will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies across Messe Berlin India’s growing portfolio of B2B exhibitions and conferences.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with excellent project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns across different industry sectors in a fast\-paced, international environment.
 



  





 Experience in the travel and tourism and/or fresh produce sectors would be an added advantage.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive event awareness, exhibitor engagement, visitor registrations, and audience growth.
* Develop compelling marketing copy and content for websites, EDMs, advertisements, social media, brochures, and other campaign materials.
* Plan, execute, and optimise targeted email and digital marketing campaigns across different audience segments.
* Work closely with Sales, Conference, Partnerships, and Project teams to develop clear and effective messaging aligned with each event's commercial and audience objectives.
* Oversee creative direction and content development to ensure consistency with event and corporate brand guidelines.
* Manage event websites and digital content, ensuring information remains accurate, engaging, and aligned with campaign objectives.
* Monitor campaign performance using Google Analytics and other reporting tools, providing insights and recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness.
* Coordinate marketing timelines, budgets, deliverables, and campaign activities across assigned events.
* Manage external agencies and vendors, including PR agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, printers, and digital partners, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Support industry partnerships, media collaborations, roadshows, and other promotional activities to strengthen event visibility and market reach.



  





***QUALIFICATIONS***



* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, exhibitions, event marketing, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, content marketing, email marketing, and social media.
* Experience with EDM platforms such as Mailchimp and other digital marketing tools.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, campaign reporting, and performance analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Creative mindset with the ability to develop engaging and commercially effective marketing campaigns.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator; knowledge of Adobe InDesign and Photoshop would be an advantage.
* Experience working within an international or multicultural business environment would be an advantage.



  





***WHY JOIN US?***




  





 At Messe Berlin India, you will be part of a growing international exhibition business with the opportunity to work across established event brands as well as new launches in the Indian market. You will collaborate with colleagues and partners across Messe Berlin’s international network and contribute to the development and growth of our exhibition portfolio in India.
 



  





 If you are ready to take the next step in your career in the exhibitions and events industry, we would be pleased to hear from you. Send your application to hr@messe\-berlin.in
 **.** 




  





*\*\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Messe Berlin India.*

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 




 The core responsibilities of Key Account Manager for Strategic Account at Perfios can be broken down into key areas: Account Management, Sales Strategy Development, Adoption \& Account Ecosystem, Customer Relationship Management, Problem Management and Revenue Growth.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Account Development**



 Manage One Large Account for Perfios with Strong business development, pipeline build \& management, Relationship building \& development, Escalation Management, Internal collaboration \& Stakeholder management skills.
 


* **Sales Strategy Development**



 The Key Account Manager is responsible for developing a comprehensive sales strategy that aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives for a large account. This involves building a strong account plan for the Strategic Account, defining sales pipeline build plan, Planning to achieve sales targets, Collections and developing pricing propositions that are competitive and sustainable.
 



 Additionally, the Account Manager must track account trends, competition, and customer needs to adjust the sales strategy as needed to maximize revenue growth, come up with innovative contracting models for large clients. Plan engagements without RFPs and work on nomination basis with the client by showcasing Perfios value proposition.
 


* **Adoption \& Building a strong account ecosystem**



 The Strategic Key Account Manager is responsible for building a strong account system through a team of Sales, Solutioning, Customer Success, Product professionals or a strategic account to achieve sales targets, stronger adoption of Perfios Tech and drive revenue growth. This involves deep collaboration skills across teams, clear roles \& responsibilities, managing extended teams and building a strong ecosystem of professionals managing the client for higher revenue performance, best account management \& good P\&L through collections.
 


* **Customer Relationship Management**



 The Strategic Key Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clients through effective communication, customer support, and proactive engagement. This involves understanding the needs of the customer, providing solutions that meet those needs, and staying ahead of any potential issues or concerns. Should be proficient with Perfios pitch \& value proposition for all the stakeholders across the client relationships. Should have the vision to get the Perfios pitch implemented through the teams as well as tailor make the pitch based on clients vision \& strategy.
 


* **Revenue Growth**



 The Strategic Key Account Manager must be focused on revenue growth, which involves increasing sales volume, Month on Month revenue growth, New Engagements going live, improving pricing strategies, and identifying and capitalizing on new sales opportunities. This requires a deep understanding of the company's sales metrics, including better adoption, Cross Sell/Upsell, average deal size, and sales cycles, which can be used to measure and track performance over time.
 



**Required experience:** 




 ● Bachelor’s degree in Business/ Master’s degree will be plus but not mandatory.

 ● Good understanding in technology

 ● Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and driving customer satisfaction

title: TALENT ACQUISITION– SOCIAL MEDIA & CREATIVE HIRING
description:
Department: Human Resources
 





 Location: Cocoma Digital HQ – Andheri West, Mumbai
 





 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-site
 





 Experience Required: 3\+ Years
 





 Reporting To: Head of HR
 




  





**ABOUT COCOMA DIGITAL \& STUDIOS** 




**Cocoma Digital \& Studios** 
 is a growing creative and marketing company managing multiple brands and businesses. Our
 **Digital division** 
 focuses on YouTube, social media, content, creator collaborations, and digital brand building, while our
 **Studios division** 
 provides end\-to\-end post\-production for films, TV, OTT, web series, and social content. We create content that
 **informs, entertains, engages, and builds communities** 
 , while delivering measurable digital growth.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist – Social Media \& Creative Hiring to manage end\-to\-end recruitment at Cocoma Digital \& Studios. The role focuses on hiring across Social Media, Creative, YouTube, Content, and Digital profiles, with strong emphasis on active sourcing and headhunting.
 



 You’ll manage sourcing, screening, interviews, trials, pipelines, stakeholder coordination, and position closures, while working to improve hiring quality and reduce TAT.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong recruitment skills, communication, follow\-up discipline, and experience hiring for social media and creative roles.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 





 1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment
 



* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding to candidate onboarding.
* Understand manpower requirements and convert them into clear hiring briefs and JDs.
* Source, headhunt, screen, shortlist, interview\-coordinate, and follow up with candidates.
* Ensure candidates move efficiently through every stage of the hiring process.
* Maintain active pipelines for current and upcoming requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned positions until successful closure and joining.




 2\. Talent Sourcing \& Headhunting
 



* Actively source and headhunt candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, institutes, creative communities, databases, and other relevant channels.
* Identify and approach passive candidates who may not be actively looking for opportunities.
* Build targeted talent maps for Social Media, Creative, YouTube, Content, Marketing, and related Digital roles.
* Develop and maintain talent pools for frequently hired and critical positions.
* Identify new and effective sourcing channels based on role requirements.
* Proactively map relevant talent from Social Media Agencies, Digital Marketing Agencies, Creative Agencies, Media Companies, and other relevant organisations.
* Build relationships with creative and social media talent communities to support ongoing hiring.




 3\. Social Media \& Creative Hiring
 



* Understand the talent requirements of a social\-focused, YouTube\-first creative business.
* Hire across social media and creative functions including:
* Social Media Managers / Executives
* YouTube Managers / Executives
* Video Editors
* Motion Graphic Designers
* Graphic Designers
* Visualisers
* Content Writers / Script Writers
* Content Creators
* Performance Marketers
* Account Managers
* Campaign Managers
* Creative Leads and other related profiles
* Understand the difference between evaluating creative talent and conventional corporate profiles.
* Review portfolios, showreels, campaign work, YouTube channels, social profiles, case studies, assignments, and relevant work samples wherever applicable.
* Identify candidates based on both skill and suitability for Cocoma’s fast\-paced creative environment.




 4\. Candidate Screening \& Evaluation
 



* Conduct initial telephonic/video screening of candidates.
* Evaluate candidates against experience, skills, communication, salary expectations, availability, portfolio/work quality, and role suitability.
* Review portfolios, resumes, work samples, trials, and assessments wherever applicable.
* Conduct structured screening based on the requirements of each role.
* Ensure only relevant and qualified candidates are forwarded to hiring managers.
* Maintain consistent screening standards across roles.




 5\. Interview, Trial \& Stakeholder Management
 



* Coordinate interviews across multiple rounds with hiring managers and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate candidate trials, assignments, assessments, and portfolio reviews wherever required.
* Ensure interview and assessment feedback is collected within defined timelines.
* Follow up with hiring managers for pending feedback and decisions.
* Maintain clear communication between candidates, HR, and hiring teams.
* Escalate delays or bottlenecks that may impact hiring timelines.
* Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process.




 6\. Recruitment Operations \& Tracking
 



* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases, interview schedules, and hiring reports.
* Track applications, sourcing, screening, shortlisting, interviews, trials/assessments, selections, offers, and joining status.
* Monitor position\-wise hiring progress and identify pipeline gaps.
* Maintain accurate recruitment MIS and daily/weekly hiring updates.
* Ensure recruitment data is updated in the designated HR systems and tools.
* Maintain proper documentation and version control across recruitment activities.




 7\. Offer \& Pre\-Onboarding Coordination
 



* Coordinate selected candidates through the offer and pre\-onboarding process.
* Conduct salary and availability discussions as per approved hiring parameters.
* Coordinate collection of required pre\-onboarding information/documents through the defined HR process.
* Maintain regular communication with selected candidates until their date of joining.
* Minimise offer dropouts and no\-shows through structured candidate engagement and follow\-ups.
* Maintain candidate relationships through the notice period and joining process.




 8\. Recruitment Analytics \& Continuous Improvement
 



* Track recruitment KPIs including hiring TAT, source effectiveness, screening\-to\-interview ratio, interview\-to\-selection ratio, offer\-to\-join ratio, and position closure.
* Identify high\-performing and low\-performing sourcing channels.
* Track the effectiveness of different headhunting and sourcing strategies.
* Recommend improvements to sourcing, screening, interview, trial, and selection processes.
* Maintain a data\-driven approach to recruitment planning and decision\-making.
* Identify recurring hiring challenges and recommend practical solutions.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Strong experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.
* Strong experience in sourcing and active headhunting.
* Experience handling multiple positions and recruitment pipelines simultaneously.
* Strong candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder and hiring\-manager coordination skills.
* Strong follow\-up, organisation, and time\-management skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment metrics and hiring processes.
* Ability to evaluate candidates across different functions and experience levels.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and target\-driven environment.
* Strong attention to detail and recruitment documentation.
* Ability to handle confidential candidate and employee information professionally.



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** 



* Prior experience in a
 **Social Media, Digital, Creative, Advertising, or Media Agency** 
 .
* Hands\-on hiring experience across
 **Social Media, YouTube, Creative, Content, Digital \& Performance Marketing** 
 roles.
* Strong experience in
 **active headhunting, passive candidate sourcing, and niche talent pipelines** 
 .
* Experience evaluating
 **creative portfolios, showreels, assignments, and trials** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS/HRMS, recruitment dashboards** 
 , and volume hiring.



  





**LANGUAGE \& COMMUNICATION PROFICIENCY** 





 English: Professional proficiency – Mandatory
 





 Hindi: Professional proficiency – Mandatory
 





 Additional regional language: Preferred, depending on client and hiring requirements
 





 The ability to communicate confidently with candidates, hiring managers, creative professionals, and senior stakeholders is essential.
 




  





**TOOLS \& TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY** 



* LinkedIn / LinkedIn Recruiter
* Naukri, Indeed, Internshala, and other job portals
* Google Workspace – Sheets, Docs, Gmail, Calendar
* Microsoft Office – Excel, Word, PowerPoint
* ATS / HRMS / Recruitment Management Systems
* Recruitment trackers and dashboards
* Basic understanding of recruitment analytics and reporting
* Familiarity with AI\-powered recruitment and candidate screening tools is preferred
* Ability to use AI tools for sourcing, JD optimisation, candidate screening, communication, and recruitment workflow automation



  





**SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)** 



* **Position closure** 
 within defined hiring TAT.
* **Quality and relevance** 
 of shortlisted and sourced candidates.
* Strong
 **headhunting and talent pipeline** 
 for critical roles.
* Improved
 **conversion rates** 
 across screening, interviews, offers, and joining.
* Low
 **candidate dropout/no\-show** 
 rate and strong candidate experience.
* **Hiring Manager satisfaction** 
 and effective stakeholder coordination.
* Accurate and timely
 **recruitment trackers, MIS, and process adherence** 
 .
* Continuous reduction in
 **time\-to\-hire and recruitment bottlenecks** 
 .



  





**A DAY AT COCOMA DIGITAL** 




 Your day involves reviewing
 **hiring priorities, candidate pipelines, interviews, and pending feedback** 
 .
 



 You’ll actively
 **source and headhunt talent** 
 across LinkedIn, databases, social platforms, creative communities, and portfolios for roles across creative, digital, and marketing functions.
 



 You’ll
 **screen candidates, coordinate interviews and trials, follow up with hiring managers, maintain talent pipelines, and drive positions towards closure** 
 .
 



 The role requires
 **ownership, speed, strong sourcing skills, persistent follow\-up, organised execution, and a focus on hiring the right talent** 
 .

**US marketplaces**

You will act as the "CEO" of our US marketplace channels, ensuring Sawai’s heritage\-rich fragrances become a household name in the North American market.
 




**Key Responsibilities**

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.
* **GTM Execution:** 

 Develop and execute the Go\-To\-Market strategy for new product launches in the US, ensuring optimal pricing, positioning, and initial review velocity.
* **Growth Roadmaps:** 

 Build monthly and quarterly growth plans that balance aggressive customer acquisition with sustainable profitability.



**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery** 



* **Listing Excellence:** 

 Own the creation and optimization of SEO\-rich product listings, including titles, bullet points, and backend keywords tailored specifically to US search intent.
* **A\+ Content \& Storefronts:** 

 Work with the content team to ensure Amazon A\+ content and Brand Stores reflect a premium, luxury fragrance aesthetic.
* **Account Health:** 

 Monitor and maintain "Gold Standard" account health metrics, managing IPI scores, buyer\-seller messaging, and compliance with platform policies.



**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)** 



* **Campaign Management:** 

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.
* **Competitor Conquesting:** 

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.

title: Independent Director
description:
More choice can disguise duplication, poor differentiation and trapped working capital. The Director will challenge the architecture of categories, opening price points, premium ladders, private labels and seasonal ranges. Management should demonstrate which customer missions each range serves, how products earn space online and in stores, and when a slow\-moving item will be marked down, returned, repurposed or exited.
 



  





 Board reporting must connect assortment breadth with availability, margin, inventory age, fulfilment complexity and customer satisfaction. Revenue growth that depends on proliferating low\-productivity stock\-keeping units should be recognised early.
 



  





 Items used for cooking, storage and household organisation can create safety, durability and disclosure obligations. The Director will examine supplier qualification, material declarations, product testing, labelling, complaint investigation, batch traceability and recall readiness. Private\-label ambition must be matched by clear ownership of specification and quality—not delegated informally to the supplier.
 



  





 When an adverse signal appears, the Board needs a decision process that protects customers before legal certainty is complete. The appointee will ask whether marketplace sellers, imported ranges and exclusive products are governed to comparable standards.
 



  





 The Director will help the Board look beyond gross billing to realised margin after discount, funding, payment cost, fulfilment, returns, damage, loyalty benefits and clearance. Supplier rebates and promotional support should be recognised only when the underlying conditions are evidenced. Channel teams must not shift inventory or cost between stores, digital operations and marketplaces to make one route appear successful.
 



  





 The Board will expect the appointee to probe price integrity, personalised offers, dark patterns, misleading scarcity messages and the fairness of refund or exchange practices.
 



  





 An omnichannel promise depends on accurate location\-level stock, dependable reservation and a rational fulfilment decision. The Director will oversee management’s response to phantom inventory, cancelled orders, split shipments, store\-pick failures, shrinkage and reverse\-logistics leakage. Investment proposals for automation, distribution capacity or new stores should be tested against demand density and the full cost to serve.
 



  





 The appointee will insist on decision\-ready store economics: mature versus ramp\-up performance, occupancy burden, local catchment, cannibalisation, labour productivity, omnichannel contribution and exit costs. Lease commitments need downside cases and explicit approval limits. A flagship’s strategic value may be real, but it must be articulated and reviewed rather than used indefinitely to excuse poor economics.
 



  





 Loyalty and personalisation can improve relevance, but they also create privacy, consent and security duties. The Director will question what data is collected, why it is retained, how models shape offers, and whether customers can exercise meaningful choice. Technology partners, payment providers, delivery networks and marketplace channels should be subject to risk\-based oversight and incident responsibilities that are understood before failure.
 



  





**The Board contribution beyond oversight** 




  





 The new Director will participate in annual strategy, capital\-allocation and leadership reviews. They should help management balance store expansion, digital capability, supply\-chain resilience, private\-label development and brand investment. The Board wants independent thinking on customer proposition and disciplined experimentation: pilots need hypotheses, decision dates and stopping rules.
 



  





 The appointee may serve on audit, risk, stakeholder or nomination and remuneration committees. They will support succession planning for merchandising, operations, technology and supply\-chain leadership; review incentives for unintended behaviours; and seek direct assurance where management information does not reconcile with customer or employee experience.
 



  





**The person sought** 




  





 The mandate suits a former chief executive, chief operating officer, commercial leader, supply\-chain leader, finance leader or digital\-retail executive who has governed a multi\-category consumer business.
 



  





 Experience with sourcing, private labels, inventory, store economics, e\-commerce or consumer protection is strongly relevant. The candidate must be comfortable moving from a customer complaint to its systemic operational and financial implications.
 



  





 Independence, curiosity and willingness to visit operations are essential. Applicants must hold active IICA Independent Directors Databank registration and disclose current interests involving suppliers, marketplaces, landlords, logistics providers, payment companies or competing retailers.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Digital Marketing Specialist
   

  

**About Finnovate:** 
 Finnovate is a holistic financial planning and wealth advisory platform. We are passionate about transforming the way Indians get personal finance advice. Our team is dedicated to providing comprehensive financial solutions that cater to the unique needs of our clients.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 This is a performance\-driven digital marketing role. You will own paid advertising, lead nurturing, email marketing, lead management, and brand campaigns, working closely with the content and design teams to execute with consistency and intent.
   

  

 You are not here to just run ads. You are here to build a digital growth engine: one that generates quality leads, nurtures them across channels until they are ready to engage, and hands them to the right advisor at the right time. Over time, you will build and lead a small marketing team.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Andheri, Mumbai (Primary) and Wadala, Mumbai (Occasionally)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Paid Advertising and Retargeting
* Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads (Search and Display), and LinkedIn.
* Build and manage retargeting audiences including website visitors, video viewers, and email lists across Meta and Google to move prospects through the funnel.
* Own ad spend allocation. Every rupee must be tracked against a measurable outcome.
* Analyse campaign performance weekly and present data\-backed recommendations to the AVP.
* Lead Nurturing
* Build and manage multi\-channel nurture journeys for all digital leads across email, WhatsApp, and paid retargeting.
* Map nurture flows to the lead's stage of awareness: cold leads receive education\-first content; warm leads receive proof and process content.
* Use retargeting ads to reinforce messaging for leads who have engaged but not yet converted.
* Set up WhatsApp touchpoints for timely, relevant follow\-up without being intrusive.
* Monitor nurture performance and refine sequences based on open rates, click throughs, and lead progression in Zoho CRM.
* The goal is simple: no digital lead should go cold due to lack of follow\-up.
* Email Marketing
* Own end\-to\-end email marketing: list management, segmentation, campaign creation, A/B testing, and reporting.
* Build automated drip journeys for new leads, client onboarding, and re\-engagement.
* Work on Zoho Marketing, Getresponse, or Mailerlite depending on campaign requirements.
* Lead Management and CRM
* Review incoming leads for quality by connecting with the lead owner to understand context and intent.
* Assign leads to the appropriate advisor or caller based on profile, product fit, and capacity.
* Track and report on lead conversion at two stages: lead to meeting, and meeting to conversion.
* Maintain lead data hygiene in Zoho CRM and flag drop\-offs and patterns that need attention.
* Work closely with the sales team to close the feedback loop between marketing input and sales output.
* Brand Awareness Campaigns
* Lead digital brand awareness initiatives: define the audience, select the channels, set the message, and measure reach and recall.
* Coordinate cross\-channel campaigns where paid, email, nurture, and content work together toward a unified objective.
* Competitor Analysis and Weekly Reporting
* Monitor competitor digital activity including ad creatives, messaging, channel mix, and positioning on an ongoing basis.
* Bring specific, actionable recommendations from competitor analysis to the weekly review.
* Prepare and present a structured weekly performance report covering paid campaigns, email, lead nurturing, lead funnel, and brand metrics.
* Own the marketing dashboard as the single source of truth for digital performance.
* Design Collaboration and Content Mix
* Brief the design team on visual requirements for all campaigns: ads, landing pages, emailers, and nurture creatives.
* Provide clear, specific feedback on design outputs to ensure alignment with campaign goals and brand standards.
* Recommend the content format mix (video, static, or carousel) for each campaign based on platform behaviour and audience stage. Recommendations go to the AVP for approval.
* Participate in creative discussions with the content team on ad copy, hooks, and messaging angles.
* Content Team Coordination
* Work with the content team to align ad creatives and campaign messaging with the broader content calendar.
* Coordinate briefing, review, and sign\-off of all ad\-related content before launch.
* Ensure all paid and branded content meets Finnovate's tone, positioning, and compliance standards.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 3 to 5 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience, ideally in fintech or financial services.
* Proven track record running Meta and Google Ads campaigns with measurable outcomes.
* Solid working knowledge of retargeting: pixels, custom audiences, lookalikes, and funnel sequencing.
* Experience building multi\-channel lead nurture journeys across email, WhatsApp, and paid channels.
* Experience with email marketing platforms and marketing automation workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Zoho CRM or a comparable CRM tool.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and the ability to build clear, actionable reports from data.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will review content that goes out under the Finnovate brand.
* Strong organisational skills. You will manage campaigns, a lead pipeline, nurture sequences, and a weekly reporting cycle simultaneously.


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with financial services content compliance (SEBI guidelines, AMFI standards).
* Experience with LinkedIn Ads targeting senior professionals or niche audiences.
* Understanding of landing page principles and conversion rate optimisation.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.


**Life at Finnovate**
* Health Insurance: coverage including options for dependents.
* Paid Time Off: vacation days and public holidays with full pay.
* Parental Leave: paid leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption.
* Professional Development: training, workshops, and conference access.
* Performance\-Based Incentives: variable pay tied to outcomes, not just activity.
* Employee Referral Programme: bonuses for bringing in great people.
* Team Events: regular outings and team\-building activities.
* Sunday Comp Off: employees working Sundays are eligible for a compensatory day off.


**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays off)
   

  

**Working Hours:** 
 9:30 am to 6:30 pm

description:
**Company:** 
 Procedure
   

  

**Website:** 
 Visit Website
   

  

**LinkedIn:** 
 Visit LinkedIn

 Small/Medium Business

 Bootstrapped

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹ 6\-13 Lacs PA
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a sharp, hands\-on
 **digital marketer** 
 to join our
 **Marketing team** 
 at Procedure. We're an engineering services company built with AI at our core since day one, not bolted on later. Before we dive into the job description, allow us to introduce ourselves.
   

  

 Our team is a mixed bag. Of the smart and the hard workers. Of the organised and slightly chaotic. Of the early risers and the burners of the midnight oil. We appreciate diversity and truly like having differing perspectives in the room.
   

  

 We pride ourselves on being early adopters of the latest tools, libraries and frameworks while delivering business value all the time. People who work with us fall in love with their craft. We have changed the definition of "work" for them.
   

  

**Here Are Some Of Our Beliefs About Work**
* Work is only 1 part of your life and not your entire life. We treat it as such.
* Weekends are sacred and not to be messed around with. You won't be asked to work on one.
* Commuting is a waste of time. Working from home saves you additional time. Go crazy with it.
* Asynchronous by\-default. Synchronous communication is expensive, so we default to writing docs and literature to enable async communication.


**Apart from work, we continually invest in growing you as a professional and a human.**
* Book club — broaden your horizons by picking up a book every month and have fun doing so
* P1, The Half Yearly Tech Conference — here's where we explore futuristic themes to keep you informed about what's happening in the tech space outside our office.
* Mumbai Meets AI (MMAI) — our quarterly community meetup where engineers and AI practitioners come together. You'll help shape how we take this to market.


**Growth requires mentorship**
 We believe choosing a mentor is more important than choosing a company. You'll work directly with our marketing lead, who'll mentor you on building a marketing engine from first principles — not from a playbook someone else wrote.
   

  

**What's It Like Here**
 We love debating over tools and strategies. Ahrefs or Semrush? Long\-form or programmatic? DR or traffic first? If you have opinions about why most B2B content is forgettable and how to fix it, you'll fit right in. Continuous improvement is at the heart of everything we do at work and outside.
   

  

**This sounds good. But what exactly will you work on?**
**Role**
 This isn't a "post on social media and send the weekly report" role. You'll own the systems that drive organic visibility and inbound leads for a B2B engineering consultancy targeting decision\-makers in the US and India. Here's what that looks like:
   

  

**Content SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**
 You'll own the organic pipeline end\-to\-end. That means keyword research, SERP gap analysis, on\-page optimization, and making sure our content gets cited by LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude, not just ranked on Google. We care deeply about being the answer, not just being on page one.
   

  

 You'll work with our content and engineering teams to ensure every blog, service page, and technology page is structured for both human readers and AI retrieval. Think: FAQ schema, AEO short\-answer blocks, clean heading hierarchy, internal link architecture.
   

  

**Backlink Outreach and DR Growth**
 You'll run outreach campaigns to grow our Domain Rating. That means identifying high\-DR targets, managing outreach sequences, building relationships with editors and publishers, and finding creative ways to earn editorial backlinks that actually move the needle.
   

  

 You should be comfortable reading a referring domains report in Ahrefs and knowing exactly what to do next.
   

  

**GA4, GTM, and Dashboards**
 You'll own our measurement stack. GA4 property setup, GTM container management, custom event tracking, conversion goals, and reporting. We use Looker Studio for dashboards. You'll build and maintain dashboards that the team actually uses to make decisions: traffic by channel, AI referral tracking, content performance, lead attribution.
   

  

 If you've set up custom channel groups in GA4 (like tracking AI assistant referral traffic separately), we'll get along well.
   

  

**What You Won't Be Doing**
* You won't be writing blog posts. We have a content writer and a structured editorial pipeline for that.
* You won't be designing carousels or editing videos. We have a designer for that.
* You won't be posting on LinkedIn and X. We have someone handling social execution.
* Your job is the engine underneath all of it: the data, the visibility, the systems, and the growth.


**Here's What We Expect From You**
* 3\-4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience, preferably in a B2B or tech services context. You've done this before, not just read about it.
* SEO is second nature to you. You understand keyword difficulty, search intent, content gaps, internal linking strategy, and technical SEO basics (crawlability, canonical tags, structured data). You've moved the needle on organic traffic for a real website.
* You've done AEO and GEO, not just read about them. Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization are not buzzwords to you. You've structured content that got cited by LLMs, tracked that traffic, and tied it back to pipeline. You've had targets around AI\-driven MQLs and you've hit them. We want someone who's proven this works, not someone who's still tinkering.
* You've set up GA4 properties from scratch, configured GTM containers, created custom events, and built dashboards in Looker Studio (or similar). You can trace a lead from first touch to form submission.
* You've done backlink outreach. You know the difference between a directory listing and an editorial backlink. You've used Ahrefs (or Semrush/Moz) to analyze competitor backlink profiles and find opportunities.
* You can build dashboards people actually look at. Looker Studio, Google Sheets with data connectors, or similar. You know that a dashboard nobody checks is worse than no dashboard at all.
* You've worked on websites and landing pages. You've been involved in building, optimizing, or managing website pages and landing pages that convert. You understand what makes a high\-intent page work: structure, copy, CTAs, page speed, and how it all ties back to the funnel.
* You use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT as thinking partners. For research, for ideation, for breaking down complex problems. Not for copy\-pasting AI\-generated fluff. You know the difference, and it shows in your work.
* You write clearly. Not blog posts, but briefs, reports, Slack messages, outreach emails. Clear thinking shows up in clear writing.


**Tools you'll work with**
* SEO/AEO: Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog
* Analytics: GA4, GTM, Looker Studio
* AI: Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus (premium licenses provided)
* Ops: Notion, Slack
* Outreach: Email (your preferred tool), LinkedIn


**The fine print**
* Experience: 3\-4 years
* Location: Mumbai (Bhandup West, Hybrid)
* Reports to: Marketing Head
* Team: You'll collaborate daily with our content writer, social media manager, designer, and engineering team.


 If you've read this far and thought "this is exactly the kind of marketing I want to do," we should talk. Apply now.

title: Brand Marketing- Digital Product Engineering & AI
description:
**Brand Marketing\- Digital Product Engineering \& AI** 




  





**BOMBAYDC \| Mumbai, Andheri West (onsite)** 




  





**About BOMBAYDC** 




 BOMBAYDC is a digital product engineering company that helps enterprises grow revenue, improve customer adoption and reduce the cost of doing business through digital products, platforms, engineering and AI.
 



 We work differently from traditional technology and design companies.
 



 Rather than starting only with a business or technology problem, we start with the customer: what they are trying to accomplish, where the experience is failing them, and what is preventing them from taking the desired action. We work backwards from these customer needs into business strategy, experience, intelligence and engineering.
 



 Our work spans digital banking, commerce, enterprise platforms and consumer products for some of India's leading organisations.
 



 As technology and AI reshape the digital services industry, we are now looking for a sharp marketer who can help us build the next chapter of the BOMBAYDC brand.
 



  





**The Role:** 



* We are looking for a Marketing Lead who can position BOMBAYDC as a leading digital product engineering company and build sustained visibility for the firm among enterprise decision\-makers.
* This is not a social media management role.
* We need someone who understands technology, digital products, engineering and AI well enough to turn our capabilities, work and thinking into a compelling market narrative.
* You will own how BOMBAYDC presents itself to the outside world, across our website, content, social media, search, PR, events and thought leadership.
* The mandate is simple: Make the right people understand what BOMBAYDC does, why we are different, and why they should consider us for important digital product and engineering mandates.



  





**What You Will Own:** 




**1\. Positioning \& Brand Narrative** 



* Own and continuously sharpen BOMBAYDC's positioning as a digital product engineering company, moving market perception beyond UI/UX or design.
* Translate our capabilities across customer strategy, AI, experience and engineering into a clear and differentiated proposition.
* Build strong narratives around our core practices, including BFSI, Commerce and Enterprise/Consumer Products.
* Ensure that everything we communicate reinforces one consistent market position.



**2\. Website \& Digital Presence** 



* Own the BOMBAYDC website as our most important marketing asset.
* Continuously improve its structure, messaging, practice pages, case studies and content to reflect where the company is headed.
* Ensure that new work, client wins, launches, capabilities, leadership perspectives and company news are always current.
* Work with our internal design and engineering teams to continuously improve the website rather than treating it as a one\-time project.



**3\. Content \& Thought Leadership** 



* Build and run a strong content engine for BOMBAYDC.
* Identify topics where we should have a point of view across AI, digital products, banking, commerce, customer experience and engineering.



 Turn internal knowledge and client work into:
 



 ● Case studies
 



 ● Articles and POVs
 



 ● White papers and reports
 



 ● LinkedIn content
 



 ● Leadership content
 



 ● Client conversations and interviews
 



 ● Videos and other relevant formats You will not be expected to personally write everything. You will, however, be expected to know what we should be talking about, why it matters, and ensure it gets produced well.
 



**4\. Social \& Leadership Presence** 



* Build a consistent and high\-quality presence for BOMBAYDC and its leadership, particularly on LinkedIn.
* Move beyond routine company posts and create formats that demonstrate our thinking and expertise.
* This could include conversations with CXOs, client roundtables, industry perspectives, project stories, engineering insights, AI experiments and leadership viewpoints.



**5\. PR \& Industry Visibility** 



* Build relationships with relevant technology, business, marketing and industry publications. Identify stories worth taking to the media: major launches, client work, new capabilities, AI initiatives, research and leadership perspectives.
* Drive a steady rhythm of meaningful media visibility rather than occasional press releases.



**6\. Search, SEO \& AI Discoverability** 



* Own BOMBAYDC's organic discoverability.
* Improve our visibility for the areas in which we want to build business, across traditional search as well as AI\-driven discovery/GEO.
* Work towards BOMBAYDC appearing when enterprise decision\-makers research digital product engineering partners, AI\-led digital transformation, banking platforms, commerce transformation and related capabilities.
* Track what is driving qualified traffic and continuously improve it.



**7\. Events \& Market Engagement** 



* Identify the right conferences, industry forums, awards, roundtables and networking opportunities for BOMBAYDC.
* Evaluate where we should attend, speak, participate, partner or host. Create our own opportunities to bring together clients and industry leaders through roundtables, conversations and focused events.



  





**Who We Are Looking For:** 




 Someone with approximately 6–10 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally within:
 



 Digital product engineering, technology services, digital transformation, IT services, product consulting, enterprise SaaS or a similar business.
 



  





**You should:** 




 ● Understand how technology services companies sell to enterprises.
 



 ● Be comfortable discussing digital products, engineering, AI and customer experience.
 



 ● Be able to simplify complex capabilities into sharp market propositions.
 



 ● Have strong writing and storytelling judgment.
 



 ● Understand content marketing, LinkedIn, SEO and digital distribution.
 



 ● Have exposure to PR, events and thought leadership.
 



 ● Be comfortable working directly with founders, business leaders, designers and engineers.
 



 ● Be extremely hands\-on. This is not a role for someone who only manages agencies and reviews presentations.
 



 ● Have strong ownership and execution discipline.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 Within the first 12 months, we should see:
 



**A clearer market position** 



* People increasingly understand BOMBAYDC as a digital product engineering company rather than primarily a UI/UX or design firm.



**A stronger digital footprint** 



* Our website becomes current, deeper and more representative of our capabilities and practices.



**A consistent content engine** 



* High\-quality case studies, perspectives, articles and leadership content go out consistently.



**Greater discoverability** 



* Improved visibility across Google and AI\-led discovery for strategically important topics.



**Stronger industry visibility** 



* More relevant media coverage, speaking opportunities, roundtables and industry participation.



**Commercial impact** 




 Marketing increasingly contributes to conversations, opportunities and inbound enquiries from the kind of enterprise clients BOMBAYDC wants to work with.
 



  





**Most Important:** 




 We are not looking for someone to simply run our social media calendar.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can understand the business deeply, identify what makes BOMBAYDC relevant in a rapidly changing technology market, turn that into a sharp narrative, and then make sure that narrative reaches the people who matter.
 



  





 If you enjoy figuring out what a company should stand for and then building the machinery that makes the market notice it, we would like to speak with you.

title: Performance Marketing Associate
description:
**About Us** 




 Skybound Wealth Management is a global financial advisory company with employees across the UK, USA, Switzerland, Cyprus, Spain and UAE. We provide tailored financial advice to international clients, supported by expert teams across wealth planning, compliance and operations.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Skybound Wealth Management is an international IFA firm serving expatriates across the UK, UAE/GCC, Portugal, Spain, Australia and other markets. Our Performance Marketing team runs paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn to generate qualified leads for our advisory business.
 



  





 We are looking for a Performance Marketing Associate to join a growing team and support the day to day planning, execution, reporting and analysis of paid campaigns across our core platforms.
 



  





 This is a hands on, execution focused role suited to someone early in their performance marketing career who wants to build deep, practical expertise across paid platforms, reporting and campaign optimisation, with clear growth into a more senior campaign ownership role over time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Campaign Planning \& Execution
 


* Assist in planning and setting up paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Build and launch ad sets, audiences, creatives and campaign structures as briefed by the team lead.
* Support day to day campaign management, including budget pacing, bid adjustments and pausing/scaling ad sets.
* Coordinate with design and content resources to get creatives and copy ready for launch.
* Keep campaign naming, UTM tagging and account structure consistent and organised.



  





 Reporting \& Analysis
 


* Prepare regular performance reports across platforms (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn) covering spend, leads, CPL, CTR and other key metrics.
* Track daily and weekly lead and appointment numbers and flag performance issues early.
* Support the team lead with campaign level analysis to identify what is and isn't working.
* Maintain reporting sheets and dashboards accurately and on schedule.
* Pull data from ad platforms and the CRM to support reporting and optimisation decisions.



  





 Platform \& Tools
 


* Work across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and LinkedIn Campaign Manager on a daily basis.
* Develop a working understanding of conversion tracking basics (pixels, conversion events, lead forms).
* Support testing of creatives, audiences and campaign structures under the team lead's guidance.
* Stay current on platform updates, new ad formats and best practices.



  





**Required Experience \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Mass Media or a related discipline.
* 0 to 2 years of experience in performance or digital marketing; internship or hands on project experience with paid ads is acceptable.
* A working understanding of paid advertising concepts, including campaigns, ad sets/groups, targeting, bidding and budgets.
* Exposure to at least one major ad platform (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or LinkedIn Campaign Manager) preferred.
* Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets for reporting and data tracking.
* Prior exposure to the BFSI, wealth management or financial services space is a plus, but not required.



  





**Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with numbers and data.
* Detail oriented, with good campaign hygiene and organisation.
* Willingness to learn platforms and processes quickly.
* Clear written communication for reporting and internal updates.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* A proactive, ownership driven attitude.



  





**Growth Opportunity** 




 This role sits within a growing performance marketing function supporting Skybound's international lead generation engine. As you build platform expertise and demonstrate ownership, there is a clear path to take on greater campaign responsibility, larger budgets and eventually independent ownership of specific markets or platforms.
 



  





 Skybound Wealth Management is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background

 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

 This is a Strategic opportunity to lead the growth engine at BrowserStack, a role that demands a rare blend of deep business ownership, pipeline management, and creative technical oversight.

* Coordinate cross\-border collaboration with overseas Group offices to build referral models and corridor growth plans

 If you want to shape a cross\-border strategy with clear commercial impact this role offers the scope to make it happen. title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Company** 




 About Keplin Global Services India Pvt. Ltd.Keplin Group is a fast\-growing, multi\-brand consumer goods and e\-commerce business, operating across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and D2C channels. We hold licensed brand partnerships including Disney and Bluey, and our operations span the UK (Uxbridge HQ and Stratford\-upon\-Avon warehouse) and India. This role sits within Keplin Global Services, our Navi Mumbai\-based entity, which provides critical back\-office and operational support to the wider Keplin Group. Joining Keplin Global Services means being part of a dynamic, international team driving the growth of some of the most loved brands in the consumer goods space.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 About the roleOwn the delivery of Keplin's marketing across e\-commerce, content and campaigns, working to Marketing manager. You will plan and run campaigns, write the copy that carries them, take new products to market, keep our marketplace and web presence sharp, and report on what worked. Broad and hands\-on: writing, planning and numbers in the same week.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* What you will do Campaign management. Plan and execute marketing campaigns across e\-commerce channels, social media, email and digital ads, from brief through to calendar, assets, scheduling and sign\-off
* Product launches. Coordinate go\-to\-market for new Keplin products, writing launch assets, ad copy and product positioning
* Content strategy. Write engaging copy for web pages, product descriptions, email newsletters and promotional ads, and shape what we say where
* Page structure. Plan module hierarchy on web pages: what modules a page needs, in what order, what each is there to do, and the headlines and content within them
* Marketplace optimisation. Assist with promotional assets and messaging for online marketplaces
* SEO alignment. Work alongside our SEO specialist as the link into marketing, making sure blogs, web copy and page structure align with the SEO plan. You need to understand the discipline well enough to brief it, question it and act on it, not to deliver it yourself
* Performance tracking. Monitor campaign performance, tracking ROI, conversion rates and traffic metrics, and use the data to shape what we do next
* Competitor research. Ongoing market research on e\-commerce trends, pricing strategies and competitor product offerings
* Commercial checks. Pull and interpret Shopify reporting on stock position and product\-level sales, flagging problems before a campaign goes live so we are not driving traffic to lines that are low or out of stock
* AI tooling. Use tools such as Claude as a normal part of your workflow, for drafting copy, structuring pages and speeding up research



  





**Qualifications** 



* What you need Four to six years in marketing, ideally consumer goods or e\-commerce



  





**Required Skills** 



* Genuinely strong copywriting in English. Much of this role is words, and we will ask for samples
* Track record taking products to market: launch planning, positioning and the assets that carry it
* A working understanding of SEO: how search works, what a specialist will ask of you, and why it shapes how a page is written and structured. You will not be doing the technical work
* A feel for content structure — why a page is ordered the way it is and what each section is meant to achieve
* Comfortable planning campaigns and reporting on them with real numbers rather than activity summaries
* Confident in a CMS, with enough HTML to fix your own problems
* Shopify experience: navigating admin, running reports, and reading stock and sales data with a commercial eye
* Active user of AI tooling, and able to show us how you use it
* Organised, accurate and reliable to a deadline



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Nice to have Klaviyo experience, particularly building email content and templates
* Marketplace experience — Amazon Seller Central or similar
* Exposure to paid social or Google Ads
* GA4 or similar analytics



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your updated resume to: rohinigujar@keplin\-group.com
